$comment: Generated by scripts/build-mcp-catalog.mjs alongside /mcp-catalog.json (which adds every input schema). Live totals: GET /api/mcp-census.
method: Computed, never typed: each hosted endpoint is counted by importing the exact catalog, resource table and prompt set it serves, and each stdio package by loading its server in-process and calling tools/list, resources/list and prompts/list over an in-memory MCP transport. tools: every tool an endpoint can serve, including financial-tier tools the policy hides until a session enables them (defaultOn is what a fresh session sees). resources: fixed-URI resources/list entries. templates: resources/templates/list entries. prompts: prompts/list entries rendered against that endpoint's own catalog. unique: distinct tool names across all servers. /api/mcp-chatgpt and /api/mcp-grok serve subsets of /api/mcp-studio, so per-server figures overlap and unique is the headline total. Recomputed on every build (public/mcp-catalog.json, public/tools.json) and on every request to /api/mcp-census; npm run check:mcp-counts fails the gate when a doc quotes a number that no longer matches.

tools.name: getting_started
tools.title: Getting Started (free)
tools.whenToUse: Call this first to orient.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.title: Search the three.ws asset catalog
tools.whenToUse: Use this before generating anything: if the catalog already has the prop or character, dropping it in is instant and free where generating one is not.

tools.name: get_catalog_item
tools.title: Read one catalog item
tools.whenToUse: Use this after search_catalog to inspect one result before you embed it; for paste-ready code call get_item_source instead.

tools.name: get_item_source
tools.title: Get paste-ready source for a catalog item
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you are ready to put a catalog item on a page or in an app; call get_catalog_item first if you still need its license or metadata.

tools.name: list_my_avatars
tools.title: List my avatars
tools.whenToUse: Use this to find the id of an avatar you already own before rendering, embedding, or attaching it to an agent; to browse other people's avatars call search_public_avatars instead.

tools.name: get_avatar
tools.title: Get avatar
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you already have an avatar id or owner+slug and need its model_url or metadata; to find ids call list_my_avatars or search_public_avatars.

tools.name: search_public_avatars
tools.title: Search public avatars
tools.whenToUse: Use this to find characters to render when you do not already know an avatar id; for your own avatars call list_my_avatars instead.

tools.name: render_avatar
tools.title: Render avatar
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the user wants to see and rotate an avatar inline; for a flat image file call render_avatar_image, and for a snippet to paste on another site call get_embed_code.

tools.name: render_avatar_image
tools.title: Render an avatar to an image
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you need a still image rather than an interactive viewer; for a live 3D view call render_avatar.

tools.name: delete_avatar
tools.title: Delete avatar
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the user explicitly asks to remove one of their avatars; confirm which one with get_avatar first.

tools.name: get_embed_code
tools.title: Get embed code
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the user wants to show an avatar, agent, or creation on a site they control; for an embed that only token holders can view call create_gated_embed instead.

tools.name: create_gated_embed
tools.title: Create a token-gated embed
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the embed should render only for holders of a token; for an open embed anyone can see call get_embed_code.

tools.name: validate_model
tools.title: Validate glTF/GLB model
tools.whenToUse: Use this before shipping, minting, or embedding a model to catch spec errors; for size and structure stats call inspect_model.

tools.name: inspect_model
tools.title: Inspect glTF/GLB model
tools.whenToUse: Use this to learn what a model contains; for ways to make it smaller call optimize_model, and for spec errors call validate_model.

tools.name: optimize_model
tools.title: Suggest optimizations for a glTF/GLB model
tools.whenToUse: Use this when a model is too heavy to load quickly on the web or on mobile; for raw counts without advice call inspect_model.

tools.name: diff_models
tools.title: Diff two glTF/GLB models
tools.whenToUse: Use this after optimizing, rigging, or re-exporting a model to confirm the new version is still safe wherever the old one was used.

tools.name: print_analyze
tools.title: Check whether a 3D model can be printed
tools.whenToUse: Use this before print_quote to check whether a model can be printed at all and how small it can go in each material.

tools.name: print_quote
tools.title: Price a real 3D print and get a signed quote
tools.whenToUse: Use this after print_analyze says the model is printable, when the user wants to know what a physical copy would cost.

tools.name: list_animations
tools.title: List animation presets
tools.whenToUse: Use this to discover valid `animation` values for apply_animation.

tools.name: animation_signature
tools.title: Measure what an animation clip actually does
tools.whenToUse: Use it to pick clips by what they do rather than by name.

tools.name: find_similar_animations
tools.title: Find clips with similar measured motion
tools.whenToUse: Use it for "more like this": alternatives when a clip does not fit a slot, or variety without changing the mood.

tools.name: apply_animation
tools.title: Apply an animation preset to a rigged model
tools.whenToUse: Use this to put a ready-made motion from list_animations on your own rigged model; for a motion the library does not have, call text_to_animation.

tools.name: text_to_animation
tools.title: Generate an animation from a text prompt and retarget it onto a model
tools.whenToUse: Use this when no preset in list_animations fits the motion you want; when one does, apply_animation is faster and repeatable.

tools.name: list_sign_vocabulary
tools.title: List the ASL vocabulary
tools.whenToUse: Use it to know in advance what a phrase will sign versus spell.

tools.name: sign_text
tools.title: Sign text in ASL
tools.whenToUse: Use this to make an avatar sign a phrase; to check beforehand which words will be signed rather than spelled, call list_sign_vocabulary.

tools.name: solana_agent_reputation
tools.title: Get Solana agent reputation
tools.whenToUse: Use this for a quick trust read on a Solana agent; for the individual records behind it call solana_agent_attestations, and for identity plus reputation in one call use solana_agent_passport.

tools.name: solana_agent_attestations
tools.title: List Solana agent attestations
tools.whenToUse: Use this to audit the individual feedback, validation, and dispute records behind a Solana agent reputation score; for the computed summary call solana_agent_reputation.

tools.name: solana_agent_passport
tools.title: Get Solana agent passport
tools.whenToUse: Use this when one tool call should answer "who is this agent and can I trust them?".

tools.name: pumpfun_recent_claims
tools.title: Recent pump.fun claims
tools.whenToUse: Use to answer 'what's happening on pump.fun right now?'.

tools.name: pumpfun_token_intel
tools.title: Pump.fun token intel
tools.whenToUse: Use this before buying or discussing one pump.fun token; to vet the wallet that launched it call pumpfun_creator_intel.

tools.name: pumpfun_creator_intel
tools.title: Pump.fun creator intel
tools.whenToUse: Use this to judge whether a launcher has a track record of real launches before trusting a new coin from that wallet.

tools.name: pumpfun_recent_graduations
tools.title: Recent pump.fun graduations
tools.whenToUse: Use this to see which pump.fun coins just left the bonding curve; for a deep read on one of them call pumpfun_token_intel.

tools.name: create_agent
tools.title: Create an agent
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the user wants a new agent; call list_my_agents first if they may already have one that fits.

tools.name: call_agent
tools.title: Call agent
tools.whenToUse: Use this to delegate specialized tasks.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.title: Register an agent on-chain
tools.whenToUse: Use this after create_agent when the agent needs a verifiable on-chain identity.

tools.name: attach_avatar_to_agent
tools.title: Give an agent a body
tools.whenToUse: Use this after saving a rigged avatar, to make it the permanent body of one of your agents.

tools.name: identity_check
tools.title: Screen an agent identity for impersonation
tools.whenToUse: Use this before creating or publishing an agent to catch a name or description that copies an existing one.

tools.name: list_my_agents
tools.title: List my agents
tools.whenToUse: Use this first to get the agent ids that recall, list_custom_skills, attach_avatar_to_agent and call_agent need.

tools.name: list_available_skills
tools.title: Browse community skills
tools.whenToUse: Use this to find a ready-made skill before writing one from scratch with create_custom_skill.

tools.name: import_community_skill
tools.title: Import a community skill onto an agent
tools.whenToUse: Use this after list_available_skills when a registry skill fits; to write your own instead call create_custom_skill.

tools.name: list_custom_skills
tools.title: List an agent's custom skills
tools.whenToUse: Use this to see what an agent already follows, and whether it all fits the budget, before adding or editing a skill.

tools.name: get_custom_skill
tools.title: Get one custom skill
tools.whenToUse: Call this before delete_custom_skill and show the user the skill, or before update_custom_skill to see the text you are changing.

tools.name: create_custom_skill
tools.title: Write a custom skill for an agent
tools.whenToUse: Use this when no registry skill fits (check list_available_skills) and the agent needs standing instructions of your own.

tools.name: update_custom_skill
tools.title: Edit or toggle a custom skill
tools.whenToUse: Use this to change a skill in place, including switching it off without deleting it.

tools.name: delete_custom_skill
tools.title: Delete a custom skill
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the user explicitly wants the skill gone for good.

tools.name: browse_external_skills
tools.title: Browse external skill registries
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the owner wants a ready-made skill for an agent instead of writing one.

tools.name: scan_external_skill
tools.title: Scan an external skill for install
tools.whenToUse: Call this first for any skill picked from browse_external_skills; nothing can be installed without its request_id.

tools.name: install_external_skill
tools.title: Install a scanned external skill
tools.whenToUse: Call this once the owner has approved the scanned request, within its 24 hours.

tools.name: external_skill_update_diff
tools.title: Check an imported skill for upstream changes
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the owner asks whether an imported skill has upstream updates.

tools.name: skill_fork
tools.title: Fork a skill
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the owner wants to change a skill they did not write, or keep their own copy of one.

tools.name: skill_publish
tools.title: Publish a skill to the three.ws registry
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the owner wants to share a skill they wrote or changed with everyone on three.ws.

tools.name: remember
tools.title: Remember
tools.whenToUse: Use for durable facts: who the user is (type=user), guidance/corrections (feedback), ongoing work (project), or external pointers (reference).

tools.name: recall
tools.title: Recall
tools.whenToUse: Use this before answering when an agent should draw on what it already knows about the user or the work; to save a new fact call remember.

tools.name: forget
tools.title: Forget
tools.whenToUse: Use this when a stored memory is wrong or outdated, or the user asks the agent to forget it; find the id with recall.

tools.name: oracle_top_plays
tools.title: Oracle top conviction plays
tools.whenToUse: Use this to decide which coins to buy before they move.

tools.name: oracle_coin
tools.title: Oracle verdict for one coin
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you already have a specific mint in mind; for the ranked board of current plays call oracle_top_plays.

tools.name: oracle_arm_watch
tools.title: Arm agent Oracle watch
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the owner wants the agent to buy high-conviction Oracle picks on its own; check the setup and results afterwards with oracle_watch_status.

tools.name: oracle_watch_status
tools.title: Oracle watch status + track record
tools.whenToUse: Use this to verify the agent is armed correctly and to review its performance before scaling up.

tools.name: trader_leaderboard
tools.title: Top pump.fun traders
tools.whenToUse: Use this to find leaders worth copying, then call trader_profile for full details before you copy one.

tools.name: trader_profile
tools.title: Full track record for one agent
tools.whenToUse: Use this to vet an agent before calling copy_subscribe.

tools.name: trade_receipt
tools.title: Why an agent took one trade
tools.whenToUse: Use this to understand what a leader actually trades on before copying it, passing a trade_id from trader_profile's recent_trades.

tools.name: sentiment_scout
tools.title: Sourced momentum candidates (Sentiment Scout)
tools.whenToUse: Use this to find which pump.fun coins are gaining momentum right now and why; for a full conviction verdict on one coin call oracle_coin.

tools.name: copy_subscribe
tools.title: Subscribe to copy a trader
tools.whenToUse: Use this after vetting a leader with trader_profile, when the user wants to mirror that leader's trades.

tools.name: copy_status
tools.title: My copy subscriptions
tools.whenToUse: Use this to check that copy-trading is set up correctly and to see which subscriptions are generating intents.

tools.name: mint_3d_asset
tools.title: Mint a 3D asset as a Solana NFT
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the user wants a model to exist as an ownable, tradable on-chain asset; to read one back call get_3d_asset_onchain.

tools.name: get_3d_asset_onchain
tools.title: Resolve a 3D NFT to its live asset + provenance
tools.whenToUse: Use this to check who holds a 3D NFT and what its provenance and royalty terms are.

tools.name: crypto_data
tools.title: Crypto Data API
tools.whenToUse: Use this for raw data from one named provider endpoint; for a merged one-call view of a Solana token call token_snapshot.

tools.name: token_snapshot
tools.title: Crypto token snapshot
tools.whenToUse: Use this for a quick general market read on one Solana token (price, liquidity, supply) without choosing providers yourself.

tools.name: generate_garment
tools.title: Generate a wearable garment from a text prompt
tools.whenToUse: Use this when nothing in list_garment_catalog fits and the user wants a new wearable item made.

tools.name: garment_status
tools.title: Check a garment generation job
tools.whenToUse: Use this after generate_garment to follow the job until it finishes.

tools.name: list_garment_catalog
tools.title: List the wardrobe garment catalog
tools.whenToUse: Use this to pick an existing garment before generating a new one with generate_garment.

tools.name: list_feedback
tools.title: List feedback
tools.whenToUse: Use this to decide which visitor-reported bug to fix next.

tools.name: get_feedback_repro
tools.title: Compile a feedback report into a failing test
tools.whenToUse: Use it to reproduce the bug before changing anything, and to prove the change worked.

tools.name: home_status
tools.title: Home status
tools.whenToUse: Use this to answer "is the house locked?", "are the lights on downstairs?", or before proposing an action, so you act on what the house is rather than what you assume.

tools.name: home_list_macros
tools.title: List home scenes and scripts
tools.whenToUse: Call this before home_activate so you propose something that exists.

tools.name: home_grants
tools.title: Standing home permissions
tools.whenToUse: Call this before proposing something that would otherwise need a confirmation: if the entity is already granted, there is no prompt to warn the user about.

tools.name: home_activate
tools.title: Activate a home scene
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the user asks for a household routine in plain words; if no scene or script fits, use home_call instead.

tools.name: home_call
tools.title: Call a home service
tools.whenToUse: Use this when no scene fits.

tools.name: read_resource
tools.title: Read a three:// resource
tools.whenToUse: Use this to read account, agent, wallet, or catalog state that has no dedicated tool, or to see what is readable when unsure.

tools.name: agent_card_search_merchants
tools.title: Search card merchants
tools.whenToUse: Use this first when the owner wants to buy a gift or prepaid card, then pick a product with agent_card_search_gift_cards.

tools.name: agent_card_search_gift_cards
tools.title: Search gift and prepaid card products
tools.whenToUse: Use this after agent_card_search_merchants to choose a product and an allowed amount, then pass both to agent_card_quote.

tools.name: agent_card_quote
tools.title: Quote a card purchase
tools.whenToUse: Use this before agent_card_create, and show the confirm table to the owner before buying.

tools.name: agent_card_create
tools.title: Buy a card from the agent wallet
tools.whenToUse: Use this after the owner said yes to the exact quote; follow the card afterwards with agent_card_status.

tools.name: agent_card_list
tools.title: List agent cards
tools.whenToUse: Use this to find a card id or see what the agent has bought; for one card with its full audit trail call agent_card_get.

tools.name: agent_card_get
tools.title: Get one agent card
tools.whenToUse: Use this to answer who paid for, revealed, or changed a card and when; for the code or PIN itself go through agent_card_data and agent_card_reveal.

tools.name: agent_card_status
tools.title: Refresh a card from the provider
tools.whenToUse: Use this when a card is still processing, or to confirm it was delivered before revealing it.

tools.name: agent_card_balance
tools.title: Card balance
tools.whenToUse: Use this before agent_card_withdraw, or when the owner asks how much is left on a card.

tools.name: agent_card_data
tools.title: Card data and reveal preview
tools.whenToUse: Call this before agent_card_reveal, which needs the preview_id it returns.

tools.name: agent_card_reveal
tools.title: Reveal a card secret once
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the owner asks for the code to redeem the card, and at no other time.

tools.name: agent_card_cancel
tools.title: Cancel a card
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the owner no longer wants a quoted or pending card.

tools.name: agent_card_withdraw
tools.title: Withdraw a prepaid balance to USDC
tools.whenToUse: Use this to recover unspent value from a prepaid card into the agent wallet.

tools.name: agent_card_connect
tools.title: Card provider verification status
tools.whenToUse: Use this before the first card purchase on an account; if steps are outstanding, get the link with agent_card_connect_link.

tools.name: agent_card_connect_link
tools.title: Card provider verification link
tools.whenToUse: Use this when agent_card_connect reports identity steps still outstanding.

tools.name: paired_markets
tools.title: List paired-coin markets
tools.whenToUse: Use this before paired_launch_quote to choose which markets a new coin should pair with.

tools.name: paired_coins
tools.title: List paired coins
tools.whenToUse: Use this to browse launched paired coins; for one coin in full call paired_coin.

tools.name: paired_coin
tools.title: Read a paired coin
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you have a coin address and need its live pools, trades, or price history.

tools.name: paired_launch_quote
tools.title: Quote a paired-coin launch
tools.whenToUse: Use this before paired_launch and show the result to the owner; paired_launch needs the quote_id this returns.

tools.name: paired_launch
tools.title: Launch a paired coin from an agent wallet
tools.whenToUse: Use this after the owner approved a paired_launch_quote, to actually create the coin.

tools.name: paired_fees
tools.title: Read paired-coin creator fees
tools.whenToUse: Use this to see what a creator agent can collect before calling paired_claim_fees.

tools.name: paired_claim_fees
tools.title: Claim paired-coin creator fees
tools.whenToUse: Use this after paired_fees shows a claimable balance worth the gas.

tools.name: launch_lanes
tools.title: Compare launch lanes
tools.whenToUse: Use this first when someone wants to launch a coin and has not picked a chain or venue; Solana is the default lane.

tools.name: uniswap_launch_quote
tools.title: Quote a Uniswap-lane launch
tools.whenToUse: Use this before uniswap_launch and show the result to the owner; uniswap_launch needs the quote_id this returns.

tools.name: uniswap_launch
tools.title: Launch a coin with a Uniswap pool
tools.whenToUse: Use this after the owner approved a uniswap_launch_quote, to actually create the coin on Base.

tools.name: launch_status
tools.title: Read a launch
tools.whenToUse: Use it after a timeout to learn whether the launch happened; a launch whose transaction landed after the request ended is settled when you read it.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.title: Get one agent you own
tools.whenToUse: Call this before delete_agent and show the user the result: its preview_id authorizes the delete.

tools.name: update_agent
tools.title: Edit an agent you own
tools.whenToUse: Use this to rename an agent or change its persona, prompt, model, skills, strategy or inference budget.

tools.name: delete_agent
tools.title: Delete an agent you own
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the owner wants an agent gone for good; to pause it instead, use stop_agent.

tools.name: start_agent
tools.title: Start an agent
tools.whenToUse: Use this to bring a stopped agent back online after stop_agent.

tools.name: stop_agent
tools.title: Stop an agent
tools.whenToUse: Use this to pause an agent without losing anything; start_agent resumes it.

tools.name: upload_agent_avatar
tools.title: Give an agent a 3D body or a portrait
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the owner has a 3D model or a picture to give an agent its body or portrait.

tools.name: create_agent_run
tools.title: Give an agent a goal to pursue on its own
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the owner wants an agent to work toward a goal on its own over several steps.

tools.name: update_agent_run
tools.title: Pause, resume, or raise the budget of a run
tools.whenToUse: Use this to pause or resume a run in progress, or to give a run that is running out of budget more room.

tools.name: cancel_agent_run
tools.title: Cancel a run
tools.whenToUse: Use this when a run should stop for good; to hold it and continue later, pause it with update_agent_run.

tools.name: get_agent_run_steps
tools.title: Read a run step by step
tools.whenToUse: Use this to see what a run did, check its receipts, or follow a live run step by step.

tools.name: automation_list
tools.title: List automations
tools.whenToUse: Call this first to find the automation id that automation_get, automation_update, automation_delete and automation_trigger take.

tools.name: automation_get
tools.title: Get one automation
tools.whenToUse: Call this before automation_delete and show the user the result: its preview_id authorizes the delete.

tools.name: automation_create
tools.title: Create an automation
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the owner wants an agent to act on its own when a price, schedule, balance, tip, launch or whale event happens.

tools.name: automation_update
tools.title: Edit an automation
tools.whenToUse: Use this to retune or switch an existing automation on or off instead of deleting and recreating it.

tools.name: automation_delete
tools.title: Delete an automation
tools.whenToUse: Use this when an automation should be removed for good; to pause it, use automation_update with enabled: false.

tools.name: automation_trigger
tools.title: Fire an automation now
tools.whenToUse: Use this to test an automation, or to fire it once on demand without waiting for its trigger.

tools.name: agent_mail_get_address
tools.title: Get the agent email address
tools.whenToUse: Call this before quoting a send.

tools.name: agent_mail_quote
tools.title: Quote a mailbox or a send
tools.whenToUse: Use this first whenever the owner asks to create a mailbox, send or reply.

tools.name: agent_mail_create
tools.title: Create the agent mailbox
tools.whenToUse: Use this once the owner approved a create quote.

tools.name: agent_mail_send
tools.title: Send an email
tools.whenToUse: Use this once the owner approved a send quote.

tools.name: agent_mail_reply
tools.title: Reply to an email
tools.whenToUse: Use this once the owner approved a reply quote.

tools.name: agent_mail_list
tools.title: List the agent inbox
tools.whenToUse: Use this to check the inbox or find a message id.

tools.name: agent_mail_read
tools.title: Read one email
tools.whenToUse: Use this to open a message from agent_mail_list or agent_mail_search.

tools.name: agent_mail_search
tools.title: Search the agent mailbox
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the owner asks about mail from a sender or on a topic.

tools.name: agent_mail_delete
tools.title: Delete an email
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the owner asks to remove a message.

tools.name: get_whitelist
tools.title: Get wallet allowlist
tools.whenToUse: Use this before proposing or removing an address, or to check why a send was refused as not whitelisted.

tools.name: add_to_whitelist
tools.title: Propose a wallet allowlist destination
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the agent needs a new payout destination and the owner must decide whether to trust it.

tools.name: remove_from_whitelist
tools.title: Remove a wallet allowlist destination
tools.whenToUse: Use this when an address is no longer trusted or a proposal was a mistake; take the entry id from get_whitelist.

tools.name: domain_search
tools.title: Search web domains
tools.whenToUse: Use this first when the owner wants a domain but has not settled on an exact name.

tools.name: domain_check
tools.title: Check one web domain
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the owner has one exact name in mind, before domain_register_quote.

tools.name: domain_pricing
tools.title: List domain TLD pricing
tools.whenToUse: Use this to compare extension prices or find TLDs under a budget without spending live registrar requests.

tools.name: domain_register_quote
tools.title: Quote a domain registration
tools.whenToUse: Call this before domain_register, once the owner has picked a name.

tools.name: domain_register
tools.title: Register a domain (spends credits)
tools.whenToUse: Call this once the owner has approved a fresh domain_register_quote.

tools.name: domain_status
tools.title: Poll a domain registration

tools.title: Connect a domain to an agent page

tools.name: domain_connect_status
tools.title: Check a connected domain
tools.whenToUse: Use this after domain_connect to check when the domain is serving over HTTPS.

tools.name: getting_started
tools.title: Getting Started (free)
tools.whenToUse: Call this first to orient.

tools.name: wallet_status
tools.title: Check the agent's wallet
tools.whenToUse: Call this before pay_and_call to confirm there's balance and headroom.

tools.whenToUse: Use this before monetize_endpoint, or whenever an agent needs an address to receive USDC.

tools.title: Publish a paid endpoint to earn USDC
tools.whenToUse: Use this when your agent already serves an API and you want other agents to pay per call for it.

tools.name: read_resource
tools.title: Read a three:// resource
tools.whenToUse: Use this for a one-call snapshot of account, wallet, or launch state when no dedicated tool covers it.

tools.name: get_linked_accounts
tools.title: List everything linked to the account
tools.whenToUse: Call it before set_external_wallet to see what a change would replace.

tools.name: set_external_wallet
tools.title: Attach a wallet you control as a payout wallet
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the owner wants an agent's earnings paid out to a wallet they control.

tools.name: browse_marketplace
tools.title: Browse agents for sale
tools.whenToUse: Use this to shop for an agent to buy; open one with get_listing for its bids and history before bidding.

tools.name: browse_public_agents
tools.title: Browse public agents
tools.whenToUse: Use this to search every published agent by name, not only those for sale; for the for-sale list with prices and time left call browse_marketplace.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.title: Get an agent listing
tools.whenToUse: Use this before place_bid or buy_now to check what transfers, the live balance, and the bids already in.

tools.name: get_marketplace_history
tools.title: Get marketplace history
tools.whenToUse: Use this to audit what happened to an agent or the market over time; for the current state of one listing call get_listing.

tools.name: preview_marketplace_action
tools.title: Preview a marketplace action
tools.whenToUse: Call this before every money-moving marketplace action: show the table to the user, wait for a clear yes, then call the action tool with its confirm flag and this preview_id (valid ten minutes, one use).

tools.name: create_marketplace_listing
tools.title: List an agent for sale
tools.whenToUse: Use this to put an agent up for sale, after the user approves a preview_marketplace_action (action create_listing) table; pass its preview_id with confirm_listing: true.

tools.name: delist_marketplace_listing
tools.title: Delist an agent
tools.whenToUse: Use this to end a sale early, after the user approves a preview_marketplace_action (action delist) table; pass its preview_id with confirm_delist: true.

tools.name: place_bid
tools.title: Bid on an agent
tools.whenToUse: Use this to make an offer instead of paying the buy-now price, after the user approves a preview_marketplace_action (action place_bid) table; pass its preview_id with confirm_bid: true.

tools.name: buy_now
tools.title: Buy an agent now
tools.whenToUse: Use this to buy at the listed price without waiting on the seller, after the user approves a preview_marketplace_action (action buy_now) table; pass its preview_id with confirm_payment: true.

tools.name: get_my_bids
tools.title: My bids
tools.whenToUse: Use this to check whether your offers are still open, won, or refunded.

tools.name: get_received_bids
tools.title: Bids on my listings
tools.whenToUse: Use this to review offers before accept_marketplace_bid or reject_marketplace_bid.

tools.name: accept_marketplace_bid
tools.title: Accept a bid
tools.whenToUse: Use this to sell to one specific bidder, after the user approves a preview_marketplace_action (action accept_bid) table; pass its preview_id with confirm_accept: true.

tools.name: reject_marketplace_bid
tools.title: Reject a bid
tools.whenToUse: Use this to decline one offer without ending the sale; to end the sale and refund every bid call delist_marketplace_listing.

tools.name: withdraw_marketplace_bid
tools.title: Withdraw my bid
tools.whenToUse: Use this to take back an offer you no longer want, after the user approves a preview_marketplace_action (action withdraw_bid) table; pass its preview_id with confirm_withdraw: true.

tools.name: get_agent_transfer
tools.title: Settlement progress
tools.whenToUse: Use this after a buy or an accepted bid to confirm the agent fully changed hands; if a step failed, call resume_agent_transfer.

tools.name: resume_agent_transfer
tools.title: Resume a stalled sale
tools.whenToUse: Use this when get_agent_transfer shows a step stopped on an error and you do not want to wait for the cron.

tools.name: predictions_events
tools.title: Browse prediction markets
tools.whenToUse: Use this to find an event and its id; open one with predictions_event for market ids and live prices.

tools.name: predictions_event
tools.title: Research one prediction event
tools.whenToUse: Use this to get the market ids predictions_open_preview and predictions_watch need, and to read the resolution rules before betting.

tools.name: predictions_positions
tools.title: The agent's prediction positions
tools.whenToUse: Use this to check PnL and find positions to sell with predictions_close_preview or claim with predictions_redeem_preview.

tools.name: predictions_open_preview
tools.title: Preview a prediction order
tools.whenToUse: Call this before every predictions_open and show the user the result.

tools.name: predictions_open
tools.title: Place a prediction order
tools.whenToUse: Use this after the user approves a predictions_open_preview; pass its fresh preview_id with confirm_trade: true.

tools.name: predictions_close_preview
tools.title: Preview closing a prediction position
tools.whenToUse: Call this before every predictions_close and show the user the expected proceeds.

tools.name: predictions_close
tools.title: Close a prediction position
tools.whenToUse: Use this to exit a position before it resolves, after the user approves that preview; pass its fresh preview_id with confirm_trade: true.

tools.name: predictions_redeem_preview
tools.title: Preview redeeming a resolved position
tools.whenToUse: Use this once an event has resolved, to see what a position can claim before predictions_redeem.

tools.name: predictions_redeem
tools.title: Redeem a resolved prediction position
tools.whenToUse: Use this after the event resolves in your favor and the user approves a predictions_redeem_preview; pass its fresh preview_id with confirm_trade: true.

tools.name: predictions_watch
tools.title: Watch a prediction market
tools.whenToUse: Use this to wait for a price level instead of polling predictions_event.

tools.name: perps_markets
tools.title: List perpetual futures markets
tools.whenToUse: Call this first to find a market symbol and its leverage limit before previewing an order.

tools.name: perps_market_data
tools.title: Read one perps market
tools.whenToUse: Use this to judge depth and funding before previewing an order.

tools.name: perps_account
tools.title: Read an agent perps account
tools.whenToUse: Use this to check equity, margin and liquidation risk before sizing a new order or withdrawing collateral.

tools.name: perps_positions
tools.title: List perps positions and orders
tools.whenToUse: Use this to find the id of an order or trigger to cancel, or to review recent fills.

tools.name: perps_order_preview
tools.title: Preview a perps order
tools.whenToUse: Use this before perps_order_execute to see the exact fill, fees and liquidation price.

tools.name: perps_action_preview
tools.title: Preview a perps funds or kill-switch action
tools.whenToUse: Call this first for any deposit, withdrawal, cancel or flatten, and show the owner the result.

tools.name: perps_order_execute
tools.title: Place a perps order
tools.whenToUse: Call this after the owner approved a perps_order_preview, within its two-minute window.

tools.name: perps_collateral_deposit
tools.title: Deposit perps collateral
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the perps account needs more margin to open or hold positions.

tools.name: perps_collateral_withdraw
tools.title: Withdraw perps collateral
tools.whenToUse: Use this to bring idle margin back to the agent wallet.

tools.name: perps_order_cancel
tools.title: Cancel a perps order or trigger
tools.whenToUse: Use this to pull one resting order or trigger listed by perps_positions; to close everything at once, use perps_flatten.

tools.name: perps_flatten
tools.title: Perps kill switch: flatten everything
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the owner wants all perps risk off immediately.

tools.name: perps_limits
tools.title: Tighten perps limits and set alerts
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the owner wants to reduce an agent's perps risk or be alerted before a position gets into trouble.

tools.name: token_search
tools.title: Search Solana tokens
tools.whenToUse: Call this first when the user names a token by symbol or name, so every later tool gets the right mint.

tools.name: get_price
tools.title: Live token price
tools.whenToUse: Use this for a quick price check on one token.

tools.name: get_indicators
tools.title: Technical indicators
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the user asks for technical analysis or a trend read on a token.

tools.name: get_market_signals
tools.title: Market signals
tools.whenToUse: Use this to judge whether a token, or the market as a whole, is heating up or cooling down before trading.

tools.name: get_news_feed
tools.title: Crypto news feed
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the user asks what is happening with a token or the market, or to check the news before a trade.

tools.name: arbitrage_prices
tools.title: Cross-venue prices
tools.whenToUse: Use this to compare venues for a pair before choosing where to swap, or to spot a cross-venue spread.

tools.name: arbitrage_quote
tools.title: Two-leg arbitrage quote
tools.whenToUse: Use this after arbitrage_prices shows a spread, to judge whether it is worth trading.

tools.name: swap_quote
tools.title: Compare swap routes
tools.whenToUse: Call this first for any swap; swap_simulate and swap_execute need its quote_id.

tools.name: swap_simulate
tools.title: Simulate a quoted swap
tools.whenToUse: Use this after swap_quote when you want proof the transaction would land before asking the user to confirm.

tools.name: swap_execute
tools.title: Execute a quoted swap
tools.whenToUse: Call this after the user said yes to a swap_quote confirmation table.

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.title: Value an agent's portfolio
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the user asks what an agent holds, what it is worth, or how risky its wallet is.

tools.name: get_balance_history
tools.title: An agent's net-worth history
tools.whenToUse: Use this to chart or describe how an agent's net worth changed over time.

tools.name: get_pnl
tools.title: An agent's profit and loss
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the user asks whether an agent is making or losing money, and from what.

tools.name: sniper_status
tools.title: Sniper status
tools.whenToUse: Use this to check whether an agent's sniper is armed and how it is performing.

tools.name: sniper_activate_preview
tools.title: Preview arming the sniper
tools.whenToUse: Call this before sniper_activate, every time.

tools.name: sniper_activate
tools.title: Arm the sniper
tools.whenToUse: Call this after the owner approved what sniper_activate_preview showed.

tools.name: sniper_deactivate
tools.title: Disarm the sniper
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the owner wants the sniper to stop buying, or with kill: true to stop it hard.

tools.name: sniper_subscribe
tools.title: Follow a signal feed
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the owner wants an agent to follow another trader's signals, starting on paper.

tools.name: alert_rule_create
tools.title: Create an alert rule
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the user wants to hear about a launch, a graduation, a price level or a whale buy without trading.

tools.name: alert_rule_list
tools.title: List alert rules
tools.whenToUse: Call this first to find a rule id, and before alert_rule_delete.

tools.name: alert_rule_delete
tools.title: Delete an alert rule
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the user no longer wants a rule's notifications.

tools.name: duel_challenge
tools.title: Challenge another agent to a duel
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the owner wants to pit one of their agents against another owner's agent.

tools.name: duel_accept
tools.title: Answer a duel challenge
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the owner wants to accept, decline or withdraw a pending challenge.

tools.name: duel_details
tools.title: Duel details
tools.whenToUse: Use this to follow one duel's standing or check where a challenge stands.

tools.name: duel_markets
tools.title: Duels, challenges and leaderboard
tools.whenToUse: Call this first to find a duel_id or challenge_id, or to see the leaderboard.

tools.name: invoice_create
tools.title: Create an invoice
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the agent needs to request a payment from someone.

tools.name: invoice_details
tools.title: Read one invoice
tools.whenToUse: Use this to check one invoice's payments and history.

tools.name: invoice_list
tools.title: List invoices
tools.whenToUse: Use this to review what the agent has billed and what is still outstanding.

tools.name: invoice_verify
tools.title: Check an invoice on-chain now
tools.whenToUse: Use this when a payer says they paid and the invoice still shows open.

tools.name: invoice_cancel
tools.title: Cancel an open invoice
tools.whenToUse: Use this when an unpaid invoice is wrong or no longer needed.

tools.name: agent_send_preview
tools.title: Preview a transfer
tools.whenToUse: Call this first for any transfer, and show the user the result before agent_send.

tools.name: agent_send
tools.title: Send funds from the agent wallet
tools.whenToUse: Call this after the user approved an agent_send_preview.

tools.name: offer_list
tools.title: Browse offers
tools.whenToUse: Call this first when the agent wants to buy something from another agent.

tools.name: agent_sell
tools.title: List an offer for sale
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the owner wants the agent to sell a file, key, code or text.

tools.name: agent_buy
tools.title: Quote a purchase
tools.whenToUse: Call this first for any purchase from offer_list.

tools.name: agent_buy_confirm
tools.title: Pay for a quoted purchase
tools.whenToUse: Call this after the user approved an agent_buy quote.

tools.name: spending_check
tools.title: Read this agent's spending limits
tools.whenToUse: Use this before a send or purchase to see whether it fits the caps, or after one was blocked.

tools.name: spending_setup
tools.title: Propose a change to this agent's limits
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the caps keep blocking work the owner wants done.

tools.name: order_preview
tools.title: Preview an order
tools.whenToUse: Call this first for any limit, stop, trailing, ladder or OCO order.

tools.name: limit_order_create
tools.title: Place a limit order
tools.whenToUse: Call this after the user approved the matching order_preview.

tools.name: stop_order_create
tools.title: Place a stop order
tools.whenToUse: Call this after the user approved the matching order_preview.

tools.name: trailing_order_create
tools.title: Place a trailing stop
tools.whenToUse: Call this after the user approved the matching order_preview.

tools.name: ladder_order_create
tools.title: Place a ladder
tools.whenToUse: Call this after the user approved the matching order_preview.

tools.name: oco_order_create
tools.title: Place an OCO pair
tools.whenToUse: Call this after the user approved the matching order_preview.

tools.name: limit_order_list
tools.title: List orders
tools.whenToUse: Use this to review an agent's open orders or find an order id to cancel.

tools.name: limit_order_cancel
tools.title: Cancel an order
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the user wants a resting order gone; for a DCA schedule use dca_cancel.

tools.name: limit_order_history
tools.title: Order history
tools.whenToUse: Use this to see why an order fired, failed or was skipped.

tools.name: order_book
tools.title: Agent order book
tools.whenToUse: Use this to see what an agent will do next on a cluster and why anything is stuck.

tools.name: dca_preview
tools.title: Preview a DCA schedule
tools.whenToUse: Call this before dca_create, and show the owner what it would place.

tools.name: dca_create
tools.title: Create a DCA schedule
tools.whenToUse: Call this after the user approved a dca_preview.

tools.name: dca_list
tools.title: List DCA schedules
tools.whenToUse: Use this to check a schedule's progress or find the id dca_cancel needs.

tools.name: dca_cancel
tools.title: Cancel a DCA schedule
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the owner wants a DCA schedule to stop.

tools.name: getting_started
tools.title: Getting Started (free)
tools.whenToUse: Call this first to orient.

tools.name: text_to_3d
tools.title: Generate a 3D model from a text prompt
tools.whenToUse: Use this to make a new object from words; call image_to_3d instead when you already have a picture, and run auto_rig_model on the result when it needs to move.

tools.name: image_to_3d
tools.title: Reconstruct a 3D model from one or more images
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you have a photo or render of the object; for a text idea call text_to_3d instead, and run remove_background first when the image has a busy background.

tools.name: generation_status
tools.title: Check a 3D generation job
tools.whenToUse: Call this after any studio tool returns a job_id (text_to_3d, image_to_3d, capture_scene, remesh_model, stylize_model, segment_model, retexture_model, retexture_region, auto_rig_model) and keep polling until it reports done or failed.

tools.name: capture_scene
tools.title: Reconstruct a 3D scene from a video
tools.whenToUse: Use this to capture the geometry of a REAL scene from footage; text_to_3d and image_to_3d instead synthesize a single object mesh.

tools.name: preview_3d
tools.title: Preview any GLB as an interactive 3D artifact
tools.whenToUse: Use it to view a generated model, or any GLB on the web.

tools.name: remove_background
tools.title: Remove the background from an image
tools.whenToUse: Use this before image_to_3d when the source image has a cluttered background, since a clean cutout reconstructs into a cleaner mesh.

tools.name: remesh_model
tools.title: Remesh, simplify, repair, or convert a 3D model
tools.whenToUse: Use this to repair, decimate, or convert a mesh before shipping it; for a stylized look call stylize_model, and for a new surface texture call retexture_model.

tools.name: stylize_model
tools.title: Apply a one-click geometric stylization filter to a 3D model
tools.whenToUse: Use this for a quick voxel, brick, lattice, or low-poly look on an existing mesh; to change surface colour call retexture_model instead.

tools.name: segment_model
tools.title: Split a 3D model into named, separable parts
tools.whenToUse: Use this before hiding, recolouring, replacing, or exporting individual parts of a model; to repaint one area of the surface without splitting the mesh call retexture_region instead.

tools.name: retexture_model
tools.title: Paint a new texture onto a 3D model from a text prompt
tools.whenToUse: Use this to repaint a whole model from a prompt; to change only one area call retexture_region instead.

tools.name: retexture_region
tools.title: Repaint one masked region of a model's texture (magic brush)
tools.whenToUse: Use this to fix or recolour one area of an already textured model; to repaint the whole surface call retexture_model instead.

tools.name: auto_rig_model
tools.title: Auto-rig a static 3D model (skeleton + skin weights)
tools.whenToUse: Use this after text_to_3d or image_to_3d when the model should move: generate a mesh, rig it, then drive it with apply_animation or pose_model.

tools.name: pose_model
tools.title: Resolve a text prompt to a pose-studio seed + joint rotations
tools.whenToUse: Use this to pose a character rigged with auto_rig_model or to get a reproducible pose link from a description; for motion over time call apply_animation instead.

tools.name: direct_prompt
tools.title: Optimize a rough idea into a 3D-generation prompt (IBM Granite)
tools.whenToUse: Use this before text_to_3d when a prompt is vague, conflicting, or multi-subject.

tools.name: generate_material
tools.title: Generate a glTF PBR material from a description (IBM Granite)
tools.whenToUse: Use this to get material values for a mesh you are assembling yourself; to paint real texture images onto a model call retexture_model instead.

tools.name: save_avatar
tools.title: Save a generated GLB as a durable, named avatar
tools.whenToUse: Use this after generation_status returns a finished glb_url worth keeping, since provider URLs expire.

tools.name: create_agent_persona
tools.title: Mint a persistent, living agent persona from a rigged GLB
tools.whenToUse: Use this once a rigged model should become a recurring character the agent speaks through; to keep a GLB in your avatar library instead call save_avatar.

tools.name: get_agent_persona
tools.title: Reload a persisted persona by id (continuity across sessions)
tools.whenToUse: Use this when a conversation starts and the user returns to a named agent.

tools.name: persona_say
tools.title: Speak a reply through a persona: lip-sync + emotion + gesture
tools.whenToUse: Use this whenever the persona speaks, on every turn, with the persona_id from create_agent_persona or get_agent_persona.

tools.name: cad_generate
tools.title: Generate a parametric CAD part (STEP, STL, GLB)
tools.whenToUse: Use it for brackets, enclosures, mounts, gears, knobs, clips, adapters and other functional parts with real dimensions; use text_to_3d instead for organic or decorative models.

tools.name: cad_rebuild
tools.title: Rebuild a CAD part with new dimensions
tools.whenToUse: Use this to change the dimensions of an existing cad_generate design without regenerating it; for a different shape call cad_generate with parent_id instead.

tools.name: validate_spatial_response
tools.title: Validate a Spatial MCP 3D artifact
tools.whenToUse: Use it to conform a third-party 3D tool result to the shape so any Spatial-MCP renderer can display it.

tools.name: export_ar
tools.title: Export a model for AR ("View in your space")
tools.whenToUse: Use it after generating a model so the user can place it on their desk through their phone.

tools.name: verify_provenance
tools.title: Verify a 3D model authenticity (content credential)
tools.whenToUse: Use this to check a GLB someone shares before trusting or reusing it; to issue a credential for your own model call anchor_provenance.

tools.name: anchor_provenance
tools.title: Anchor a signed content credential for a 3D model
tools.whenToUse: Use this after generating a model you plan to publish or sell, so its authorship can be proven later with verify_provenance.

tools.name: grade_sim_readiness
tools.title: Grade a 3D model for physics simulation
tools.whenToUse: Use this before importing a model into a simulator or game engine; when the verdict is needs_repair, run remesh_model and grade it again.

tools.name: persona_identity
tools.title: Read a persona's on-chain identity: wallet, reputation, holdings
tools.whenToUse: Use this to show who a persona is on-chain or to check its balance before persona_payment_preview, persona_tip, or persona_send.

tools.name: persona_payment_preview
tools.title: Preview a USDC payment from a persona's wallet (no funds move)
tools.whenToUse: Call this before persona_tip or persona_send to preview the transfer: the persona's wallet and live USDC balance, the recipient, the amount, the balance afterwards, the session spend so far against its cap, and every rule that would refuse the transfer.

tools.name: persona_tip
tools.title: Tip USDC from a persona's own wallet
tools.whenToUse: Use this for a small thank-you payment to another agent after persona_payment_preview; for general payments call persona_send instead.

tools.name: persona_send
tools.title: Send USDC from a persona's own wallet
tools.whenToUse: Use this to settle a hire, pay an invoice, or fund another wallet after persona_payment_preview; for a small thank-you tip call persona_tip instead.

tools.name: x402_preflight
tools.title: Check whether an x402 seller can actually settle before paying it
tools.whenToUse: Call this before paying any x402 endpoint to check whether that seller can currently SETTLE what it charges.

tools.name: inspect_model
tools.title: Inspect glTF/GLB model
tools.whenToUse: Use this to learn what a model contains; for ways to make it smaller call optimize_model, and for spec errors call validate_model.

tools.name: optimize_model
tools.title: Suggest optimizations for a glTF/GLB model
tools.whenToUse: Use this when a model is too heavy to load quickly on the web or on mobile; for raw counts without advice call inspect_model.

tools.name: list_animations
tools.title: List animation presets
tools.whenToUse: Use this to discover valid `animation` values for apply_animation.

tools.name: animation_signature
tools.title: Measure what an animation clip actually does
tools.whenToUse: Use it to pick clips by what they do rather than by name.

tools.name: find_similar_animations
tools.title: Find clips with similar measured motion
tools.whenToUse: Use it for "more like this": alternatives when a clip does not fit a slot, or variety without changing the mood.

tools.name: apply_animation
tools.title: Apply an animation preset to a rigged model
tools.whenToUse: Use this to put a ready-made motion from list_animations on your own rigged model; for a motion the library does not have, call text_to_animation.

tools.name: text_to_animation
tools.title: Generate an animation from a text prompt and retarget it onto a model
tools.whenToUse: Use this when no preset in list_animations fits the motion you want; when one does, apply_animation is faster and repeatable.

tools.name: read_resource
tools.title: Read a three:// resource
tools.whenToUse: Use this when your client renders tools but not MCP resources, or to follow a three:// link another tool returned.

tools.name: getting_started
tools.title: Getting Started (free)
tools.whenToUse: Call this first to orient.

tools.name: search_services
tools.title: Search the x402 bazaar
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you know what capability you need; call get_service on a match for full payment and input details.

tools.name: browse_services
tools.title: Browse the x402 bazaar
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you have no specific need yet and want to see what is on offer; for a targeted lookup call search_services instead.

tools.name: get_service
tools.title: Get full details for one x402 service
tools.whenToUse: Use this before paying any service, to confirm the exact amount, asset, and input shape.

tools.name: bazaar_service_details
tools.title: Live price details for one x402 service
tools.whenToUse: Use this instead of get_service when you only need the current price, for example on a schedule to watch a dependency's price over time and detect hikes or drops; call get_service when you also need the input/output schema and a ready pay link.

tools.name: read_resource
tools.title: Read a three:// resource
tools.whenToUse: Use this to read the whole service catalog or your account in one call when a search tool is too narrow.

tools.name: ibm_granite_getting_started
tools.title: Getting Started (free)
tools.whenToUse: Call this first to orient before invoking a paid tool.

tools.name: ibm_granite_chat
tools.title: IBM Granite Chat ($0.02)
tools.whenToUse: Use this for open-ended conversation or free-form text generation; for code tasks call ibm_granite_code, and for structured JSON extraction call ibm_granite_analyze.

tools.name: ibm_granite_code
tools.title: IBM Granite Code ($0.025)
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the input is source code or a request to write code; for general conversation call ibm_granite_chat instead.

tools.name: ibm_granite_embed
tools.title: IBM Granite Embed ($0.005)
tools.whenToUse: Use this to index documents or compare texts by meaning; it returns vectors, not prose, so call ibm_granite_chat when you need a written answer.

tools.name: ibm_granite_analyze
tools.title: IBM Granite Analyze ($0.04)
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you need machine-readable fields (entities, sentiment, risks) from a document rather than the free-text reply ibm_granite_chat gives.

tools.name: ibm_granite_forecast
tools.title: IBM Granite Forecast ($0.05)
tools.whenToUse: Use this to project a numeric series of at least 64 timestamped points forward; it returns numbers only, so pass the result to ibm_granite_analyze if you need commentary.

tools.name: forge_free
tools.title: Generate a 3D model from text
tools.whenToUse: Use this for a single object or creature from text; for a posable character call forge_avatar, and to change a model you already made call refine_model.

tools.name: text_to_avatar
tools.title: Generate a 3D avatar
tools.whenToUse: Use this for a character that only needs to be viewed; when it must be posed or animated call forge_avatar instead.

tools.name: mesh_forge
tools.title: Generate a 3D mesh (art-directed)
tools.whenToUse: Use this for a single object or prop when mesh quality matters most; for characters call text_to_avatar or forge_avatar.

tools.name: rig_mesh
tools.title: Rig a 3D model for animation
