tools.name: search_tokens
tools.title: Search Tokens
tools.whenToUse: Use this to find a coin's mint when you only know its name or ticker, then pass the mint to get_token_details or get_coin_intel.

tools.name: get_token_details
tools.title: Token Details
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you already have a mint and need its metadata, market cap, and curve status; for holder concentration call get_token_holders, for recent fills call get_token_trades.

tools.name: get_bonding_curve
tools.title: Bonding Curve
tools.whenToUse: Use this to read graduation progress or the curve spot price of a coin that has not graduated yet.

tools.name: get_token_trades
tools.title: Token Trades
tools.whenToUse: Use this to read recent buy and sell flow on one coin; to see only large trades as they land, call pumpfun_watch_whales instead.

tools.name: get_trending_tokens
tools.title: Trending Tokens
tools.whenToUse: Use this to scan the largest coins on pump.fun right now; for fresh launches call get_new_tokens, for coins that left the curve call get_graduated_tokens.

tools.name: get_new_tokens
tools.title: New Tokens
tools.whenToUse: Use this to catch launches in their first minutes; for the largest coins by market cap call get_trending_tokens instead.

tools.name: get_graduated_tokens
tools.title: Graduated Tokens
tools.whenToUse: Use this to list coins that now trade on a PumpSwap pool, where pumpfun_quote_swap applies instead of get_bonding_curve.

tools.name: get_king_of_the_hill
tools.title: King of the Hill
tools.whenToUse: Use this to find the coin closest to graduating among those still on the curve; for the full ranking call get_trending_tokens.

tools.name: get_creator_profile
tools.title: Creator Profile
tools.whenToUse: Use this to vet a dev wallet's launch history before buying one of its coins; for its fee cash-outs call pumpfun_list_claims.

tools.name: get_token_holders
tools.title: Token Holders
tools.whenToUse: Use this to check whether a few wallets control the supply before buying; for price and volume call get_token_details instead.

tools.name: pumpfun_vanity_mint
tools.title: Vanity Mint Keypair
tools.whenToUse: Use this before launching a coin when its mint address should carry a recognizable prefix or suffix.

tools.name: pumpfun_watch_whales
tools.title: Watch Whale Trades
tools.whenToUse: Use this to see who is moving size on a coin right now; for the full recent tape call get_token_trades.

tools.name: pumpfun_list_claims
tools.title: List Creator Fee Claims
tools.whenToUse: Use this to audit how much a creator has already cashed out; for only the claims inside a recent window call pumpfun_watch_claims.

tools.name: pumpfun_watch_claims
tools.title: Watch Creator Fee Claims
tools.whenToUse: Use this for batch collection after a delay; for a creator's full recent claim history call pumpfun_list_claims.

tools.name: pumpfun_first_claims
tools.title: First Creator Fee Claims
tools.whenToUse: Use this to spot creators cashing out for the first time across all coins; for one creator's history call pumpfun_list_claims.

tools.name: sns_resolve
tools.title: Resolve .sol Domain
tools.whenToUse: Use this when a wallet is named by its .sol domain and you need the address; for the reverse direction call sns_reverseLookup.

tools.name: sns_reverseLookup
tools.title: Reverse .sol Lookup
tools.whenToUse: Use this to label a raw wallet address with its human-readable .sol name; to go from name to address call sns_resolve.

tools.name: social_cashtag_sentiment
tools.title: Cashtag Sentiment
tools.whenToUse: Use this to score posts you have already collected; it fetches nothing itself, so pass the posts in.

tools.name: kol_leaderboard
tools.title: KOL Leaderboard
tools.whenToUse: Use this to find which trader wallets are worth following; to see whether they hold a given coin, call get_coin_intel or get_token_holders.

tools.name: pumpfun_quote_swap
tools.title: Swap Quote (Read-Only)
tools.whenToUse: Use this to size a trade on a graduated coin, or to measure its pool depth, before executing anywhere.

tools.name: social_x_post_impact
tools.title: X Post Price Impact
tools.whenToUse: Use this to measure how one X post moved a coin that is still on its bonding curve (pricing is virtual_quote_reserves / virtual_token_reserves); a graduated coin has no curve, so the call fails rather than returning a zero price.

tools.name: get_coin_intel
tools.title: Coin Intel
tools.whenToUse: Call this before entering any position.

tools.name: get_oracle_conviction
tools.title: Oracle Conviction
tools.whenToUse: Call this when you need the highest-confidence trade signal; it synthesises everything get_coin_intel exposes into one actionable score.

tools.name: pumpfun_upload_metadata
tools.title: Upload Coin Metadata
tools.whenToUse: Call this before launching a coin — pass the returned uri to the launch-agent endpoint or the studio launch flow.

tools.name: pumpfun_bot_status
tools.title: Indexer Status
tools.whenToUse: Use this first when search_tokens, get_graduated_tokens, get_king_of_the_hill, or get_creator_profile fail or are missing, to see whether the indexer is configured and healthy.

tools.name: setWireframe
tools.title: Toggle wireframe
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the user wants to see the mesh topology or check polygon density.

tools.name: setSkeleton
tools.title: Toggle skeleton helper
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the user asks whether a model is rigged or wants to see its bones.

tools.name: setGrid
tools.title: Toggle grid
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the user needs a sense of scale or orientation for the model.

tools.name: setAutoRotate
tools.title: Toggle auto-rotate
tools.whenToUse: Use this to show a model from every side, or to stop the motion before a screenshot.

tools.name: setBgColor
tools.title: Set background color
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the user wants a specific backdrop, for contrast or to match a brand.

tools.name: setTransparentBg
tools.title: Toggle transparent background
tools.whenToUse: Use this before a screenshot that will be composited over other content.

tools.name: setEnvironment
tools.title: Set lighting environment
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the user wants to see how materials react to different light.

tools.name: takeScreenshot
tools.title: Take screenshot
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the user wants an image of the model as it looks now.

tools.name: loadModel
tools.title: Load model
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the user gives a model link or asks to view a different model.

tools.name: runValidation
tools.title: Validate model
tools.whenToUse: Use this when a model renders wrong or before publishing it, to list spec errors and warnings.

tools.name: showMaterialEditor
tools.title: Open material editor
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the user wants to adjust colors, roughness or metalness by hand.

tools.name: text_to_avatar
tools.title: Text → 3D avatar ($0.15)
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you want the Hunyuan-3D lane specifically; for an avatar that is guaranteed to come back rigged and animation-ready, call forge_avatar instead.

tools.name: mesh_forge
tools.title: Text → 3D mesh ($0.25)
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you have reference images or want the directed text chain; for a free text-only draft, call forge_free instead.

tools.name: forge_free
tools.title: Free text → 3D (TRELLIS)
tools.whenToUse: Use this for a text-only model at no cost; switch to mesh_forge for photo input or forge_avatar for a rigged character in one call.

tools.name: rig_mesh
tools.title: Rig 3D mesh ($0.20)
tools.whenToUse: Use this after mesh_forge or forge_free to rig the mesh they return; forge_avatar does both steps in one call.

tools.name: forge_avatar
tools.title: Text/Image → rigged avatar ($0.45)
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you need a character that can be posed and animated; for props and other static objects, call forge_free or mesh_forge instead.

tools.name: refine_model
tools.title: Refine a 3D model by describing a change
tools.whenToUse: Use this when a generated model is close but its shape needs a specific change; to change only the surface material without touching the mesh, call restyle_material instead, which costs less.

tools.name: restyle_material
tools.title: Restyle a 3D model’s materials — AI PBR restyle or seeded colorway variants
tools.whenToUse: Use this when only the look of the surface should change; to change the shape itself, call refine_model instead.

tools.name: ens_sns_resolve
tools.title: ENS + SNS resolve ($0.0005)
tools.whenToUse: Use this to turn a .sol or .eth name into a wallet address before looking that wallet up or paying it.

tools.name: agent_delegate_action
tools.title: Agent delegate action ($0.01)
tools.whenToUse: Use this for agent-to-agent collaboration when you already know which agent should answer; to find and pay an agent by task fit with a provenance receipt, use agent_hire_discover and then agent_hire instead.

tools.name: agent_hire_discover
tools.title: Agent hire — discover ($0.01)
tools.whenToUse: Use this before agent_hire to pick a candidate and see the exact price it will settle.

tools.name: agent_hire
tools.title: Agent hire ($0.05)
tools.whenToUse: Use this after agent_hire_discover, once you have chosen an agent and accept its quoted price.

tools.name: sentiment_pulse
tools.title: Sentiment pulse ($0.003)
tools.whenToUse: Use this to weigh community mood against the price and holder data from pump_snapshot.

tools.name: get_pose_seed
tools.title: Pose seed ($0.001)
tools.whenToUse: Use this to turn a pose description such as "warrior pose" or "waving" into exact joint rotations and a pose-studio link.

tools.name: pump_snapshot
tools.title: Pump.fun snapshot ($0.005)
tools.whenToUse: Use this to check a token's price, volume, and holder concentration before trading or reporting on it; for community mood, call sentiment_pulse.

tools.name: agent_reputation
tools.title: Agent reputation ($0.01)
tools.whenToUse: Use this to vet an agent's on-chain track record before hiring or paying it; agent_hire_discover already folds this score into its ranking.

tools.name: vanity_grinder
tools.title: Solana vanity grinder ($0.05)
tools.whenToUse: Use this to grind a fresh address with a short pattern (about 3 characters is the practical reach); for longer brandable addresses already in stock, call vanity_premium instead.

tools.name: vanity_premium
tools.title: Premium vanity inventory (browse)
tools.whenToUse: Use this to browse long brandable addresses already in stock; for a fresh grind of up to 3 characters, use the vanity_grinder tool instead.

tools.name: agenc_list_tasks
tools.title: AgenC list tasks ($0.001)
tools.whenToUse: Use this first to enumerate a wallet's AgenC tasks, then pass a task PDA to agenc_get_task for its full lifecycle timeline.

tools.name: agenc_get_task
tools.title: AgenC get task ($0.001)
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you have one task's PDA (or its creator and id) and need its current state and history; to find tasks in the first place, call agenc_list_tasks.

tools.name: agenc_get_agent
tools.title: AgenC get agent ($0.001)
tools.whenToUse: Use this to check an AgenC agent's authority, stake, and reputation before assigning it work; to see the tasks a wallet created, call agenc_list_tasks instead.

tools.name: aixbt_intel
tools.title: aixbt intel ($0.01)
tools.whenToUse: Use this to see which narratives are forming right now; for a ranked list of projects with market metrics, call aixbt_projects instead.

tools.name: aixbt_projects
tools.title: aixbt projects ($0.01)
tools.whenToUse: Use this to find which projects are gaining momentum; for the underlying narrative items, call aixbt_intel instead.

tools.name: crypto_news
tools.title: Crypto news (live, 197 feeds)
tools.whenToUse: Use this for raw, filterable headlines; for the day grouped into stories use crypto_news_digest, and for coverage older than a few days use crypto_news_archive.

tools.name: crypto_news_digest
tools.title: Crypto news digest (clustered)
tools.whenToUse: Call this first for "what happened in crypto today".

tools.name: crypto_news_archive
tools.title: Crypto news archive (660k+, 2017→)
tools.whenToUse: Use this for coverage older than a few days; for today's coverage use crypto_news or crypto_news_digest.

tools.name: get_trending_agents
tools.title: Trending agents by activity
tools.whenToUse: Use this to find which agents people are actually talking to right now; for coins call get_trending_coins, for the raw event stream call get_feed_events.

tools.name: get_trending_coins
tools.title: Trending coins by Oracle conviction
tools.whenToUse: Use this to see which coins the Oracle rates highest right now; for the agents ranking call get_trending_agents.

tools.name: get_holder_leaderboard
tools.title: $THREE holder leaderboard
tools.whenToUse: Use this to look up where a wallet ranks among $THREE holders or to page through the board; for the tier thresholds alone call get_tier_info.

tools.name: get_tier_info
tools.title: $THREE holder tier ladder
tools.whenToUse: Use this to explain what a holder's tier means, to tell a holder how far they are from the next band, or to render the leaderboard legend.

tools.name: get_feed_events
tools.title: Site-wide activity feed
tools.whenToUse: Use it for situational awareness — what agents, coins, and players are active right now.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.title: List AgenC tasks by creator
tools.whenToUse: Use this to see the work a specific creator has open or in-flight.

tools.name: get_task
tools.title: Get AgenC task detail + lifecycle
tools.whenToUse: Use this to inspect one task before claiming or funding it; to list every task a wallet created call list_tasks.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.title: Get AgenC agent registry entry
tools.whenToUse: Use this to verify another agent before coordinating with it — confirm it is registered, active, and what it claims to do.

tools.name: link_agent
tools.title: Link a three.ws identity to its AgenC agent id
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you know a three.ws handle, ERC-8004 id, or MPL-Core asset and need the matching AgenC id; if you already have the AgenC id or PDA call get_agent instead.

tools.name: query_x402_services
tools.title: Query x402 services as AgenC tasks
tools.whenToUse: Use this to discover paid work an agent can earn by calling — the x402 complement to the on-chain task marketplace.

tools.name: create_payment_session
tools.title: Create a funded agent payment session
tools.whenToUse: Use this first to give an agent a capped spending budget; then price each call with quote_session_payment and settle it with pay_with_session.

tools.name: quote_session_payment
tools.title: Quote an x402 payment against a payment session (no funds move)
tools.whenToUse: Use this before every pay_with_session call to see the price and whether the session can cover it.

tools.name: pay_with_session
tools.title: Pay an x402 endpoint via a payment session
tools.whenToUse: Use this after quote_session_payment returns a price the user has explicitly approved; it moves real USDC.

tools.name: check_payment_session
tools.title: Check a payment session's budget and status
tools.whenToUse: Use this to see how much budget one session has left before paying; for every session at once call list_payment_sessions.

tools.name: list_payment_sessions
tools.title: List payment sessions and spending stats
tools.whenToUse: Use this to audit all your sessions and total spend; for one session's detail and executions call check_payment_session.

tools.name: cancel_payment_session
tools.title: Cancel a payment session and refund unused budget
tools.whenToUse: Use this when an agent no longer needs its budget, to stop further spending and reclaim the rest.

tools.name: agora_board
tools.title: Browse the Agora job board
tools.whenToUse: Use this to find work to claim; once you pick a task, call agora_claim_task with its taskPda.

tools.name: agora_pulse
tools.title: Read the Agora economy pulse
tools.whenToUse: Use this to gauge how busy the economy is before deciding to register or post work.

tools.name: agora_citizens
tools.title: List Agora citizens
tools.whenToUse: Use it to scout collaborators, find a Verifier for your proof, or see who's earning.

tools.name: agora_passport
tools.title: Get one Agora citizen passport
tools.whenToUse: Use this to vet one citizen before hiring it or verifying its work; to browse many citizens call agora_citizens.

tools.name: agora_professions
tools.title: List Agora professions (the capability bit map)
tools.whenToUse: Use it to read a citizen's `capabilityBits` or to set a task's `requiredCapabilities` when posting work.

tools.name: agora_quote_register
tools.title: Quote an Agora registration (no funds move)
tools.whenToUse: Use this before agora_register so the user sees the stake and the signing wallet before anything is signed.

tools.name: agora_register
tools.title: Register as an Agora citizen (on-chain)
tools.whenToUse: Use this after agora_quote_register has been shown to the user and they said yes; registering is the first step before claiming or posting work.

tools.name: agora_claim_task
tools.title: Claim an open Agora task (on-chain)
tools.whenToUse: Use this after agora_board shows a task your professions qualify for; finish it with agora_complete_task.

tools.name: agora_complete_task
tools.title: Complete an Agora task with a proof (on-chain)
tools.whenToUse: Use this after you have done the work for a task you claimed with agora_claim_task, to submit the proof and collect the reward.

tools.name: agora_quote_task
tools.title: Quote an Agora bounty (no funds move)
tools.whenToUse: Use this before agora_post_task so the user sees exactly what will be locked in escrow.

tools.name: agora_post_task
tools.title: Post a bounty to the Agora board (on-chain escrow)
tools.whenToUse: Use this after agora_quote_task has been shown to the user and they said yes, to publish paid work for other citizens.

tools.name: list_alert_rules
tools.title: List my pump.fun alert rules
tools.whenToUse: Use this to audit what an agent is watching before creating or editing rules.

tools.name: create_alert_rule
tools.title: Create a pump.fun alert rule
tools.whenToUse: Use this to have three.ws watch a coin or agent around the clock; to change an existing rule call update_alert_rule instead of adding a duplicate.

tools.name: update_alert_rule
tools.title: Update a pump.fun alert rule
tools.whenToUse: Use this to pause, retune, or re-route an existing rule; unlike delete_alert_rule it keeps the rule and its history.

tools.name: delete_alert_rule
tools.title: Delete a pump.fun alert rule
tools.whenToUse: Use this when a rule is no longer wanted at all; to pause it without losing it, prefer update_alert_rule with enabled:false.

tools.name: get_alert_history
tools.title: Read fired pump.fun alert history
tools.whenToUse: Use this to review what fired; pair it with list_alert_rules, whose `recent_deliveries` shows per-channel send outcomes — to see both what fired and how it was delivered.

tools.name: qwen_chat
tools.title: Qwen Chat
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you want a written answer from Qwen; for vectors to search or cluster texts call qwen_embed instead.

tools.name: qwen_embed
tools.title: Qwen Text Embeddings
tools.whenToUse: Use this to index or compare texts by meaning; it returns vectors, not prose, so call qwen_chat when you need a written reply.

tools.name: qwen_list_models
tools.title: List DashScope Models
tools.whenToUse: Call this first to confirm a model id exists on the account before passing it to qwen_chat or qwen_embed.

tools.name: build_assistant_widget
tools.title: Build a paste-ready three.ws assistant widget embed
tools.whenToUse: Use this after list_assistant_options has shown you every avatar, background, mode and attribute you can set, to get the embed code for a website.

tools.name: list_assistant_options
tools.title: List every three.ws assistant widget option
tools.whenToUse: Call this before build_assistant_widget to know the vocabulary.

tools.name: text_to_speech
tools.title: Text to speech
tools.whenToUse: Use this when an avatar needs a voice line you can play; to get the lipsync track for that line in the same call, use audio_to_face with `text` instead.

tools.name: speech_to_text
tools.title: Speech to text
tools.whenToUse: Use this to turn a user's recorded voice into text an agent can act on; to go the other way, call text_to_speech.

tools.name: audio_to_face
tools.title: Audio to face (lipsync)
tools.whenToUse: Use this when an avatar has to mouth a spoken line; for plain audio with no face animation, call text_to_speech instead.

tools.name: motion_capture_clips
tools.title: List motion-capture clips
tools.whenToUse: Use this first to find a recorded face, pose, hand, or VMC clip, then pass its id to motion_capture_clip for the frames.

tools.name: motion_capture_clip
tools.title: Get a motion-capture clip
tools.whenToUse: Use this to drive an avatar from a clip discovered via motion_capture_clips.

tools.name: get_autopilot_config
tools.title: Get autopilot config
tools.whenToUse: Call this first, before proposing or executing.

tools.name: set_autopilot_config
tools.title: Set autopilot config
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the owner wants to grant, revoke, or cap what autopilot may do; read the current values first with get_autopilot_config.

tools.name: generate_proposals
tools.title: Generate autopilot proposals
tools.whenToUse: Use this to have the agent suggest its next actions from what it remembers; review the results with list_proposals before executing any.

tools.name: list_proposals
tools.title: List autopilot proposals
tools.whenToUse: Use this to find what is actionable (filter by status) and to get the proposal ids the other autopilot tools need.

tools.name: dryrun_proposal
tools.title: Dry-run an autopilot proposal
tools.whenToUse: Use this before every execute_proposal, and always before an irreversible wallet_transfer.

tools.name: adjust_proposal
tools.title: Adjust a pending autopilot proposal
tools.whenToUse: Use this when a proposal is right in kind but wrong in detail; adjust it, run dryrun_proposal again, then execute_proposal.

tools.name: execute_proposal
tools.title: Execute an autopilot proposal (moves real value)
tools.whenToUse: Use this after dryrun_proposal shows no blocked check and, for a wallet_transfer, after the owner has explicitly confirmed it.

tools.name: dismiss_proposal
tools.title: Dismiss a pending autopilot proposal
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the owner rejects a proposal, so the agent stops suggesting it; to reverse something already executed call undo_action instead.

tools.name: undo_action
tools.title: Undo a reversible autopilot action
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the owner wants a reversible executed action taken back; to reject a proposal that never ran call dismiss_proposal.

tools.name: list_autopilot_activity
tools.title: List autopilot activity (signed receipts)
tools.whenToUse: Use it to audit what the agent did and why.

tools.name: compute_trust
tools.title: Compute autopilot trust level
tools.whenToUse: Use this to tell the owner how much autonomy the agent has earned; for the full permission model call get_autopilot_config.

tools.name: inspect_glb
tools.title: Inspect a GLB / glTF 3D model
tools.whenToUse: Use this to see what a GLB contains and how heavy it is; to check it against the glTF spec, call validate_glb instead.

tools.name: validate_glb
tools.title: Validate a GLB / glTF against the Khronos spec
tools.whenToUse: Use this to find out why a GLB fails to load or renders wrong; for counts and file size alone, inspect_glb is lighter.

tools.name: optimize_glb
tools.title: Optimize a GLB (dedup, prune, weld, Draco)
tools.whenToUse: Use this when inspect_glb shows a model is too large to load quickly on the web.

tools.name: thumbnail_glb
tools.title: Render a GLB to a PNG thumbnail
tools.whenToUse: Use this for a quick preview image of any GLB; to apply a pose, camera orbit, or facial expression, call render_avatar instead.

tools.name: viewer_url
tools.title: Build a three.ws viewer URL + embed snippet
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the user wants a link or iframe to an interactive 3D view; for a static image, call thumbnail_glb or render_avatar instead.

tools.name: list_avatars
tools.title: List three.ws default avatars + accessories
tools.whenToUse: Use this first to pick a preset or accessory id for spawn_avatar and dress_avatar.

tools.name: list_animations
tools.title: List three.ws pose presets + animation slots
tools.whenToUse: Use this to get the ids to pass as posePresetId in render_avatar.

tools.name: spawn_avatar
tools.title: Spawn a 3D avatar session
tools.whenToUse: Call this first: dress_avatar, viewer_url, and speak all build on the session it returns.

tools.name: dress_avatar
tools.title: Apply accessories + pose to a spawned avatar
tools.whenToUse: Use this after spawn_avatar to change what a session wears or how it poses; for a still image of the result, call render_avatar with the same sessionId.

tools.name: render_avatar
tools.title: Render a posed avatar (pose + camera + expression)
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you need a posed or expressive still image; for a quick neutral thumbnail of any GLB, call thumbnail_glb instead.

tools.name: generate_avatar
tools.title: Generate a 3D avatar (Replicate text-to-3D)
tools.whenToUse: Use this when no existing GLB fits and you need a new model from a description or photo; to start from a stock body or a GLB you already have, call spawn_avatar instead.

tools.name: speak
tools.title: Avatar speaks (TTS)
tools.whenToUse: Use this when a spawned avatar session should say a line out loud.

tools.name: wallet_create
tools.title: Create a Solana wallet (optionally vanity-grinded)
tools.whenToUse: Use this when an avatar needs its own fresh Solana address; it moves no funds and touches no chain.

tools.name: wallet_balance
tools.title: Read Solana wallet balances (SOL + SPL tokens)
tools.whenToUse: Use this to check that a wallet holds enough SOL before previewing a send, buy, or launch.

tools.name: wallet_send_preview
tools.title: Preview a SOL send (no funds move)
tools.whenToUse: Call this before every wallet_send: show the preview to the user and get a clear yes before calling wallet_send with the returned preview_id.

tools.name: wallet_send
tools.title: Send SOL on Solana mainnet
tools.whenToUse: Call this after wallet_send_preview has been shown to the user and they said yes, and never without that yes.

tools.name: pump_snapshot
tools.title: Live pump.fun / Solana token snapshot
tools.whenToUse: Use this to check a token's price, liquidity, and holder concentration before quoting a buy with pump_buy_quote.

tools.name: pump_buy_quote
tools.title: Quote a token buy via Jupiter (no funds move)
tools.whenToUse: Call this before every pump_buy: show the quote to the user, get a clear yes, then call pump_buy with the returned quote_id and the same arguments.

tools.name: pump_buy
tools.title: Buy a Solana token via Jupiter (direct or Jito-bundled)
tools.whenToUse: Call this after pump_buy_quote has been shown to the user and they said yes, and never without that yes.

tools.name: pump_launch_preview
tools.title: Preview a coin launch (no funds move)
tools.whenToUse: Call this before every pump_launch: show the preview to the user, get a clear yes, then call pump_launch with the returned preview_id and the same arguments.

tools.name: pump_launch
tools.title: Atomic pump.fun launch (Jito bundle, separate funder/creator)
tools.whenToUse: Call this after pump_launch_preview has been shown to the user and they said yes, and never without that yes.

tools.name: pump_collect_preview
tools.title: Preview a creator-fee collection (no funds move)
tools.whenToUse: Call this before every pump_collect_fees: show the preview to the user, get a clear yes, then call pump_collect_fees with the returned preview_id and the same arguments.

tools.name: pump_collect_fees
tools.title: Atomic pump.fun creator-fee collection (Jito bundle)
tools.whenToUse: Call this after pump_collect_preview has been shown to the user and they said yes, and never without that yes.

tools.name: ens_sns_resolve
tools.title: Resolve ENS + SNS names to addresses
tools.whenToUse: Use this to turn a .sol or .eth name into a wallet address before checking its balance or previewing a send to it.

tools.name: get_billing_summary
tools.title: My plan, quotas, and current usage
tools.whenToUse: Use this before a heavy job to check how much of the plan is left; for what you were charged call query_usage.

tools.name: query_usage
tools.title: My metered usage / invoice statement for a period
tools.whenToUse: Use this to explain what a period's charges were for; for one charge's itemized receipt call get_receipt.

tools.name: export_billing_history
tools.title: Export my billing history as CSV
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the user wants a file for their records or accounting; to read the charges inline call query_usage.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.title: Get one receipt (per-charge or per-purchase)
tools.whenToUse: Use this to prove or itemize one specific charge or purchase; for a whole period's charges call query_usage.

tools.name: get_fee_info
tools.title: Current platform fee rate
tools.whenToUse: Use this to work out what a seller nets from a marketplace sale before quoting a price.

tools.name: blender_info
tools.title: Inspect the local Blender install
tools.whenToUse: Call it first when a tool fails, or to check that Blender is installed at all.

tools.name: blender_scene_info
tools.title: Describe a 3D file with Blender
tools.whenToUse: Use this before blender_optimize or blender_convert to see what a file contains and what is making it heavy.

tools.name: blender_convert
tools.title: Convert a 3D file between formats
tools.whenToUse: Use this to change a file's format only; to also cut triangles and texture size for the web, call blender_optimize instead.

tools.name: blender_optimize
tools.title: Shrink a 3D model for delivery
tools.whenToUse: Use this when a model is too heavy to ship to a browser or phone; run blender_scene_info first to see whether triangles or textures are the problem.

tools.name: blender_render
tools.title: Render a preview image of a 3D file
tools.whenToUse: Use it to see a model, check a conversion, or produce a thumbnail.

tools.name: blender_forge_import
tools.title: Generate a 3D model with three.ws and open it in Blender
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you need a new model that does not exist yet; to work on a file you already have, open it with blender_scene_info or blender_run_python instead.

tools.name: blender_run_python
tools.title: Run a Python script inside Blender
tools.whenToUse: Use this for scene edits the other tools do not cover: decimating meshes, joining or renaming objects, editing armatures, baking animation, cleaning materials.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.title: List LLM providers and models
tools.whenToUse: Call this first to pick a `key` for `chat`.

tools.name: chat
tools.title: Run a chat completion
tools.whenToUse: Use this to get a model's answer to a prompt from inside an agent workflow; call list_providers first to choose a model.

tools.name: get_clash_state
tools.title: Coin Clash battle board
tools.whenToUse: Use this to see who's fighting and who's winning before enlisting or rallying.

tools.name: get_clash_leaderboard
tools.title: Coin Clash leaderboard
tools.whenToUse: Use this to find the strongest armies and the heaviest hitters.

tools.name: enlist_faction
tools.title: Enlist in a Coin Clash faction
tools.whenToUse: Use this before rally_faction to get a war pass for a coin the wallet already holds; check get_clash_state first to see which factions are fighting.

tools.name: rally_faction
tools.title: Rally power for a Coin Clash faction
tools.whenToUse: Use this after enlist_faction, or with a token to auto-enlist, to add power to your faction while the round is live; get_clash_state shows the clock.

tools.name: concierge_ask
tools.title: Ask a website's AI concierge a question
tools.whenToUse: Use this to answer a question about a specific site or document; to put that same concierge on the site itself, call concierge_embed.

tools.name: concierge_embed
tools.title: Generate a Concierge embed snippet for a website
tools.whenToUse: Use this when a site owner wants the Concierge on their pages; call concierge_avatars first to choose an avatar id.

tools.name: concierge_avatars
tools.title: List available Concierge avatars
tools.whenToUse: Use this to pick an avatar id for concierge_embed's "avatar" option, or skip it and omit the option to let each visitor pick their own.

tools.name: list_subscriptions
tools.title: List my copy-trade subscriptions
tools.whenToUse: Use this to audit who you copy and how aggressively before tuning a follow with update_subscription.

tools.name: create_subscription
tools.title: Follow a leader (create / update subscription)
tools.whenToUse: Use this to start copying a leader, or to re-tune that follow by leader; to change a follow you already hold by its subscription id, call update_subscription.

tools.name: update_subscription
tools.title: Update a copy-trade subscription
tools.whenToUse: Use this to pause, resume or re-size a follow you already have (ids come from list_subscriptions); to end it outright call cancel_subscription.

tools.name: cancel_subscription
tools.title: Stop a copy-trade subscription
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the follow should end; to merely halt copies temporarily without ending it, call update_subscription with status:"paused" instead.

tools.name: get_executions
tools.title: List copy executions (intent inbox)
tools.whenToUse: Use this to see which copy intents are waiting on you, then call record_execution to mark each pending one acted or dismissed.

tools.name: record_execution
tools.title: Record acting on a copy intent
tools.whenToUse: Use this after you have traded (or chosen not to) on an intent from get_executions, so it leaves the pending inbox.

tools.name: get_earnings
tools.title: Copy-trade earnings & fees owed
tools.whenToUse: Use this to see the fees you owe the leaders you copy, or to check a leader's copy track record before following them with create_subscription.

tools.name: announce
tools.title: Tell your human, in person
tools.whenToUse: Use this for the handful of moments that deserve to interrupt someone (a long task finished, a decision is needed, something broke), not for progress chatter: the client applies an importance floor, a rate limit, quiet hours and dedupe, so noise is dropped rather than queued.

tools.name: announce_result
tools.title: Report a finished task in person
tools.whenToUse: Use this after anything long enough that the person walked away from it, instead of announce, so the urgency matches the outcome.

tools.name: check_rail
tools.title: Check the delivery rail
tools.whenToUse: Use this once when wiring an agent up, or when announce fails and you need to tell a bad key apart from an unreachable rail.

tools.name: home_overview
tools.title: Read the house: floors, rooms, lights, climate, security
tools.whenToUse: Call this before anything else: it is the vocabulary every other tool takes its arguments in.

tools.name: list_entities
tools.title: List addressable entities, filtered by domain, area or name
tools.whenToUse: Use this before writing a `call_service` call, to get the exact entity_id and whether it is guarded; for the room-by-room picture call `home_overview` instead.

tools.name: list_macros
tools.title: List the scenes and scripts this household already built
tools.whenToUse: Use this when a person asks for a mood or routine ("bedtime", "movie time") to see which macros exist, then confirm one with `preview_macro` and run it with `run_macro`.

tools.name: call_service
tools.title: Call a Home Assistant service, subject to the physical-action gate
tools.whenToUse: Use this for a single device action the household has no scene for; when one of their scenes or scripts covers it, use `run_macro` instead.

tools.name: preview_macro
tools.title: Preview which scene a phrase would run (nothing runs)
tools.whenToUse: Use this first whenever a person asks for a scene, so they see what would run before anything does.

tools.name: run_macro
tools.title: Resolve a phrase to one of the household's own scenes and run it
tools.whenToUse: Use this after the person has confirmed the match from `preview_macro`; for one device rather than a scene, use `call_service` instead.

tools.name: watsonx_chat
tools.title: Watsonx Chat
tools.whenToUse: Use this for multi-turn conversation with chat templating; for a single raw prompt with decoding control call watsonx_generate instead.

tools.name: watsonx_forecast
tools.title: Watsonx Time-Series Forecast
tools.whenToUse: Use this to project a numeric series forward; for text commentary on the result call watsonx_chat.

tools.name: watsonx_generate
tools.title: Watsonx Text Generation
tools.whenToUse: Use for completion-style tasks and fine decoding control via greedy or sampling.

tools.name: watsonx_embed
tools.title: Watsonx Embeddings
tools.whenToUse: Use this to index texts for semantic search or similarity scoring; it returns vectors, not prose.

tools.name: watsonx_tokenize
tools.title: Watsonx Tokenize
tools.whenToUse: Use to budget context and cost before a generation call.

tools.name: watsonx_list_models
tools.title: Watsonx Model Catalog
tools.whenToUse: Call this first to find a model id your account and region can run before overriding the default model on another watsonx tool.

tools.name: ibm_granite_getting_started
tools.title: Getting Started (free)
tools.whenToUse: Call this first to orient before invoking a paid tool.

tools.name: ibm_granite_chat
tools.title: IBM Granite Chat ($0.02)
tools.whenToUse: Use this for open-ended conversation or free-form text generation; for code tasks call ibm_granite_code, and for structured JSON extraction call ibm_granite_analyze.

tools.name: ibm_granite_code
tools.title: IBM Granite Code ($0.025)
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the input is source code or a request to write code; for general conversation call ibm_granite_chat instead.

tools.name: ibm_granite_embed
tools.title: IBM Granite Embed ($0.005)
tools.whenToUse: Use this to index documents or compare texts by meaning; it returns vectors, not prose, so call ibm_granite_chat when you need a written answer.

tools.name: ibm_granite_analyze
tools.title: IBM Granite Analyze ($0.04)
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you need machine-readable fields (entities, sentiment, risks) from a document rather than the free-text reply ibm_granite_chat gives.

tools.name: ibm_granite_forecast
tools.title: IBM Granite Forecast ($0.05)
tools.whenToUse: Use this to project a numeric series of at least 64 timestamped points forward; it returns numbers only, so pass the result to ibm_granite_analyze if you need commentary.

tools.name: smart_money_coin
tools.title: Smart-money score for a coin
tools.whenToUse: Use this before buying a coin to see whether reputable wallets or a single sybil cluster is behind the bid; for one wallet's record call wallet_intel.

tools.name: wallet_intel
tools.title: Wallet reputation + smart-money card
tools.whenToUse: Use this to vet one wallet before copying it or trusting its buys; to judge a coin by its buyers call smart_money_coin instead.

tools.name: signal_feed
tools.title: Signal feed track record + recent signals
tools.whenToUse: Use this to judge a feed's proven accuracy and price before subscribing to it.

tools.name: kol_leaderboard
tools.title: KOL trader leaderboard
tools.whenToUse: Use this to find the KOL traders worth watching; for what they traded on one coin call kol_trades.

tools.name: kol_trades
tools.title: Recent KOL trades on a mint
tools.whenToUse: Use this to check whether known KOLs are in or out of a coin before acting on it; for the ranked trader list call kol_leaderboard.

tools.name: copy_smart_wallets
tools.title: Copy-trade smart wallet directory
tools.whenToUse: Use this to pick wallets worth copying or following; for one wallet's full reputation card call wallet_intel instead.

tools.name: knock_quote
tools.title: Quote a door
tools.whenToUse: Call this before every knock_send on a priced door: the owner can change their price at any time, and the quote you show a human before they approve a payment must be the live one.

tools.name: knock_directory
tools.title: Browse open doors
tools.whenToUse: Use this to discover which humans an agent can pay to talk to, then call knock_quote on the one you pick.

tools.name: knock_send
tools.title: Knock on a door
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you have one message for a specific person; call knock_quote first on a priced door so the human approves the live price.

tools.name: knock_receipt
tools.title: Read a knock receipt
tools.whenToUse: Use this after knock_send to see whether the person read or answered your message.

tools.name: knock_inbox
tools.title: Read your knocks
tools.whenToUse: Use this to triage: the amount is the sender's own statement of how much reaching you was worth.

tools.name: knock_act
tools.title: Act on a knock
tools.whenToUse: Use this after knock_inbox to answer, close, or block a knock you have triaged.

tools.name: get_wallet_portfolio
tools.title: KOL wallet portfolio + P&L
tools.whenToUse: Use this to size up a specific smart trader before copying or analyzing them.

tools.name: get_wallet_trades
tools.title: A KOL wallet's trades on a mint
tools.whenToUse: Use it to inspect a single smart trader's moves before copying.

tools.name: get_loom_feed
tools.title: Browse the Loom 3D-creation gallery
tools.whenToUse: Use this to browse or pick recent community creations; for one known id call get_creation instead.

tools.name: get_creation
tools.title: Fetch one Loom creation by id
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you already have a creation id (from get_loom_feed or a submit_creation result) and need its full record or embed snippet.

tools.name: submit_creation
tools.title: Submit a creation to the Loom gallery
tools.whenToUse: Use this after the user has asked to share a specific model publicly, and only then.

tools.name: browse_agents
tools.title: Browse the agent marketplace
tools.whenToUse: Use this to find agents by topic or popularity; call agent_detail on a result for its full profile.

tools.name: agent_detail
tools.title: Fetch a marketplace agent by id
tools.whenToUse: Use this after browse_agents to read one agent's full profile, prices and tiers before hiring or forking it.

tools.name: agent_categories
tools.title: List agent marketplace categories
tools.whenToUse: Use this before browse_agents to get the category slugs it filters on.

tools.name: browse_skills
tools.title: Browse the skills catalog
tools.whenToUse: Use this to find an installable skill for a capability an agent lacks; filter with slugs from skill_categories.

tools.name: skill_categories
tools.title: List skills catalog categories
tools.whenToUse: Use this before browse_skills to get the category slugs it filters on.

tools.name: preview_agent_mint
tools.title: Preview an on-chain agent mint (no funds move)
tools.whenToUse: Use this before mint_onchain_agent every time, so the person sees the full cost before any SOL moves.

tools.name: mint_onchain_agent
tools.title: Mint an on-chain agent into the Metaplex Agent Registry
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the server holds the paying key and the person approved the preview_agent_mint cost; for Phantom/Solflare users, use prepare_agent_mint instead.

tools.name: prepare_agent_mint
tools.title: Prepare an agent mint for a Phantom/Solflare wallet to sign
tools.whenToUse: Use this instead of mint_onchain_agent when the person pays from their own browser or hardware wallet.

tools.name: send_signed_transaction
tools.title: Broadcast signed Solana transactions in order and confirm them
tools.whenToUse: Use it to complete the prepare_agent_mint flow: pass the wallet-signed txs_base64 array and the create/register sequencing (including the propagation race) is handled.

tools.name: preview_agent_identity
tools.title: Preview an Agent Identity registration (no funds move)
tools.whenToUse: Use this before register_agent_identity every time, so the person sees the cost and the document before any SOL moves.

tools.name: register_agent_identity
tools.title: Register an existing Core asset in the Metaplex Agent Registry
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the Core asset already exists and only needs its identity; to mint a NEW agent, use mint_onchain_agent or prepare_agent_mint instead.

tools.name: get_onchain_agent
tools.title: Read an on-chain agent (asset, registration, wallet)
tools.whenToUse: Use this to inspect one agent by its asset address; to discover recent agents call list_onchain_agents.

tools.name: agent_wallet
tools.title: An agent's built-in wallet, or the signer wallet, with balance
tools.whenToUse: Use this to check a balance before a mint or after funding a wallet.

tools.name: build_registration
tools.title: Build an EIP-8004 registration document (no chain access)
tools.whenToUse: Use it to preview exactly what mint_onchain_agent / register_agent_identity will write on-chain, or to host the document yourself and pass it back as registration_uri.

tools.name: list_onchain_agents
tools.title: List the latest on-chain agent registrations
tools.whenToUse: Use this to discover recent registrations; call get_onchain_agent on an address for the full record.

tools.name: three_status
tools.title: Deploy fee, $THREE holder tier, and the live buyback ledger
tools.whenToUse: Use this before a mint to tell the person what the deploy fee will be and how holding $THREE lowers it.

tools.name: sns_resolve
tools.title: Resolve a .sol name to its owner wallet
tools.whenToUse: Use this before sending to a .sol name so funds reach the wallet that owns it; for wallet to name call sns_reverse.

tools.name: sns_reverse
tools.title: Reverse-lookup a wallet to its primary .sol name
tools.whenToUse: Use this to show a readable name for a wallet address; for name to wallet call sns_resolve.

tools.name: threews_availability
tools.title: Check if a *.threews.sol agent identity is available
tools.whenToUse: Use this before claiming a *.threews.sol handle for an agent to confirm it is free.

tools.name: list_notifications
tools.title: List notifications
tools.whenToUse: Use it to surface alerts without polling, then mark_read / delete_notification to manage them.

tools.name: mark_read
tools.title: Mark notifications read
tools.whenToUse: Use this for normal triage after list_notifications; to remove a notification entirely use delete_notification instead.

tools.name: delete_notification
tools.title: Delete notification
tools.whenToUse: Use this to discard a notification entirely; prefer mark_read for normal triage.

tools.name: get_preferences
tools.title: Get notification preferences
tools.whenToUse: Call this before set_preferences so you patch from the real current state.

tools.name: set_preferences
tools.title: Set notification preferences
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the owner wants a category on or off for a channel, after reading the current matrix with get_preferences.

tools.name: register_push_device
tools.title: Register push device
tools.whenToUse: Use this when a browser has just granted push permission; use unregister_push_device to remove a device.

tools.name: unregister_push_device
tools.title: Unregister push device
tools.whenToUse: Use this when a browser or device should stop getting push; to silence a whole category everywhere use set_preferences instead.

tools.name: get_portfolio_summary
tools.title: My agents’ live portfolio (holdings + USD value)
tools.whenToUse: Use this first for "what do my agents hold"; drill into one token with get_portfolio_asset.

tools.name: get_portfolio_history
tools.title: My portfolio value over time
tools.whenToUse: Use this to chart or describe performance over time; for the current value call get_portfolio_summary.

tools.name: get_portfolio_asset
tools.title: My position in one token (holdings + market + chart)
tools.whenToUse: Use this to answer questions about one token you hold; for the whole portfolio call get_portfolio_summary.

tools.name: get_trades_feed
tools.title: Public closed-trade PnL feed
tools.whenToUse: Use this for realized PnL and closed-trade history; for current holdings call get_portfolio_summary.

tools.name: get_wallet_balances
tools.title: Live on-chain balances for a Solana wallet
tools.whenToUse: Use it to confirm the agent’s own signing wallet before a send_transfer, or to check any address.

tools.name: preview_transfer
tools.title: Preview a SOL or SPL transfer (no funds move)
tools.whenToUse: Use this before every send_transfer, so the person approves the exact recipient, amount and fees.

tools.name: send_transfer
tools.title: Send SOL or an SPL token on Solana mainnet
tools.whenToUse: Use this after preview_transfer, and only on the person's explicit yes to that recipient and amount.

tools.name: list_agent_actions
tools.title: List an agent's action-provenance trail
tools.whenToUse: Use this to audit what an agent did over time; to verify one action by id call query_action.

tools.name: query_action
tools.title: Fetch + verify one provenance action
tools.whenToUse: Use this to prove or check a single action someone cited; for the full trail call list_agent_actions.

tools.name: append_agent_action
tools.title: Append a signed action to the provenance ledger
tools.whenToUse: Use this after an agent completes a real action worth auditing, once per action.

tools.name: search_tokens
tools.title: Search Tokens
tools.whenToUse: Use this to find a coin's mint when you only know its name or ticker, then pass the mint to get_token_details or get_coin_intel.

tools.name: get_token_details
tools.title: Token Details
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you already have a mint and need its metadata, market cap, and curve status; for holder concentration call get_token_holders, for recent fills call get_token_trades.

tools.name: get_bonding_curve
tools.title: Bonding Curve
tools.whenToUse: Use this to read graduation progress or the curve spot price of a coin that has not graduated yet.

tools.name: get_token_trades
tools.title: Token Trades
tools.whenToUse: Use this to read recent buy and sell flow on one coin; to see only large trades as they land, call pumpfun_watch_whales instead.

tools.name: get_trending_tokens
tools.title: Trending Tokens
tools.whenToUse: Use this to scan the largest coins on pump.fun right now; for fresh launches call get_new_tokens, for coins that left the curve call get_graduated_tokens.

tools.name: get_new_tokens
tools.title: New Tokens
tools.whenToUse: Use this to catch launches in their first minutes; for the largest coins by market cap call get_trending_tokens instead.

tools.name: get_graduated_tokens
tools.title: Graduated Tokens
tools.whenToUse: Use this to list coins that now trade on a PumpSwap pool, where pumpfun_quote_swap applies instead of get_bonding_curve.

tools.name: get_king_of_the_hill
tools.title: King of the Hill
tools.whenToUse: Use this to find the coin closest to graduating among those still on the curve; for the full ranking call get_trending_tokens.

tools.name: get_creator_profile
tools.title: Creator Profile
tools.whenToUse: Use this to vet a dev wallet's launch history before buying one of its coins; for its fee cash-outs call pumpfun_list_claims.

tools.name: get_token_holders
tools.title: Token Holders
tools.whenToUse: Use this to check whether a few wallets control the supply before buying; for price and volume call get_token_details instead.

tools.name: pumpfun_vanity_mint
tools.title: Vanity Mint Keypair
tools.whenToUse: Use this before launching a coin when its mint address should carry a recognizable prefix or suffix.

tools.name: pumpfun_watch_whales
tools.title: Watch Whale Trades
tools.whenToUse: Use this to see who is moving size on a coin right now; for the full recent tape call get_token_trades.

tools.name: pumpfun_list_claims
tools.title: List Creator Fee Claims
tools.whenToUse: Use this to audit how much a creator has already cashed out; for only the claims inside a recent window call pumpfun_watch_claims.

tools.name: pumpfun_watch_claims
tools.title: Watch Creator Fee Claims
tools.whenToUse: Use this for batch collection after a delay; for a creator's full recent claim history call pumpfun_list_claims.

tools.name: pumpfun_first_claims
tools.title: First Creator Fee Claims
tools.whenToUse: Use this to spot creators cashing out for the first time across all coins; for one creator's history call pumpfun_list_claims.

tools.name: sns_resolve
tools.title: Resolve .sol Domain
tools.whenToUse: Use this when a wallet is named by its .sol domain and you need the address; for the reverse direction call sns_reverseLookup.

tools.name: sns_reverseLookup
tools.title: Reverse .sol Lookup
tools.whenToUse: Use this to label a raw wallet address with its human-readable .sol name; to go from name to address call sns_resolve.

tools.name: social_cashtag_sentiment
tools.title: Cashtag Sentiment
tools.whenToUse: Use this to score posts you have already collected; it fetches nothing itself, so pass the posts in.

tools.name: kol_leaderboard
tools.title: KOL Leaderboard
tools.whenToUse: Use this to find which trader wallets are worth following; to see whether they hold a given coin, call get_coin_intel or get_token_holders.

tools.name: pumpfun_quote_swap
tools.title: Swap Quote (Read-Only)
tools.whenToUse: Use this to size a trade on a graduated coin, or to measure its pool depth, before executing anywhere.

tools.name: social_x_post_impact
tools.title: X Post Price Impact
tools.whenToUse: Use this to measure how one X post moved a coin that is still on its bonding curve (pricing is virtual_quote_reserves / virtual_token_reserves); a graduated coin has no curve, so the call fails rather than returning a zero price.

tools.name: pumpfun_bot_status
tools.title: Indexer Status
tools.whenToUse: Use this first when search_tokens, get_graduated_tokens, get_king_of_the_hill, or get_creator_profile fail or are missing, to see whether the indexer is configured and healthy.

tools.name: pumpfun_token_3d
tools.title: Token 3D Snapshot
tools.whenToUse: Use this to hand a user a visual, shareable view of a coin; for the raw numbers alone call get_token_details and get_token_holders.

tools.name: compose_scene
tools.title: Compose a 3D diorama plan from one sentence
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you want to review or edit the plan, or forge the objects yourself; to get a finished GLB world in one call, use build_world instead.

tools.name: get_scene
tools.title: Fetch a saved diorama by id
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you already have a diorama id (from list_scenes or build_world) and need its objects, for example before passing them to export_scene.

tools.name: list_scenes
tools.title: List recent or featured dioramas
tools.whenToUse: Use this to discover existing dioramas and their ids; fetch one in full with get_scene.

tools.name: export_scene
tools.title: Export a forged diorama as one GLB scene
tools.whenToUse: Use this after every object in a diorama has a glbUrl and you want one downloadable GLB; to go from a sentence straight to the merged world, call build_world instead.

tools.name: build_world
tools.title: Build a complete 3D world from one sentence (no browser needed)
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you want a finished world from one sentence with no intermediate steps; to inspect or adjust the plan before anything is forged, call compose_scene instead.

tools.name: list_signal_feeds
tools.title: Browse the signal-feed marketplace
tools.whenToUse: Use this to choose a feed before subscribe_signal; to rank the publishers themselves call get_mirror_leaderboard.

tools.name: get_mirror_leaderboard
tools.title: Rank signal publishers by realized performance
tools.whenToUse: Use this to find a leader before subscribing to their feed.

tools.name: get_subscriptions
tools.title: List your signal subscriptions + delivery history
tools.whenToUse: Use this to check what you follow and what it has cost before changing a subscription with set_subscription_status.

tools.name: subscribe_signal
tools.title: Subscribe an agent to a signal feed
tools.whenToUse: Use this after picking a feed with list_signal_feeds; start in simulate mode and switch to live only on the owner's explicit say-so.

tools.name: set_subscription_status
tools.title: Resume, pause, stop, or kill a subscription
tools.whenToUse: Use this to stop a live subscription from spending or trading right now.

tools.name: decode_solana_memo_data_uri
tools.title: Decode a Solana memo data URI
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you already hold a data URI string; to pull media from a transaction call extract_solana_memo_media instead.

tools.name: extract_solana_memo_media
tools.title: Extract media from a Solana transaction memo
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you have a transaction signature; to scan an address for media call find_solana_memo_media.

tools.name: find_solana_memo_media
tools.title: Find recent memo media for a Solana address
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you have an address but no signature; for one known transaction call extract_solana_memo_media.

tools.name: get_solana_memo_media_status
tools.title: Solana memo media capability
tools.whenToUse: Use this to check which RPC hosts and memo programs the server will use before a scan.

tools.name: three_price
tools.title: Live $THREE price (Jupiter) + USD→$THREE quote
tools.whenToUse: Use this to quote $THREE in USD or size a USD amount in $THREE; for a wallet's holdings call three_balance.

tools.name: three_balance
tools.title: Read a wallet's $THREE + SOL balance
tools.whenToUse: Use this to check holdings before a three_burn or to confirm a wallet holds $THREE.

tools.name: three_burn
tools.title: Burn $THREE on-chain (incinerator + treasury split)
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the person explicitly asks to burn and has approved the USD amount; check three_balance first.

tools.name: render_avatar
tools.title: Render 3D avatar
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the user wants to see the avatar in the conversation; for an iframe to paste into a website, call avatar_embed_code instead.

tools.name: avatar_embed_code
tools.title: Get avatar embed code
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the avatar has to live on a page outside this chat; to show it here, call render_avatar instead.

tools.name: get_avatar
tools.title: Get avatar metadata
tools.whenToUse: Use this to resolve a handle to its avatar id and GLB url before rendering, embedding, or downloading it.

tools.name: load_session
tools.title: Load a tutoring session ledger
tools.whenToUse: Use this to show the learner what they owe so far; to seal the invoice call close_session.

tools.name: close_session
tools.title: Close a tutoring session (finalize invoice)
tools.whenToUse: Use this when the learner is done; call load_session first to review the tab before sealing it.

tools.name: vanity_quote
tools.title: Quote the bounty price for a vanity pattern
tools.whenToUse: Use this before posting a grind-bounty so you escrow a fair amount.

tools.name: vanity_appraise
tools.title: Appraise the rarity of a Solana address
tools.whenToUse: Use this to rate an address someone already has; to price grinding a new pattern call vanity_quote.

tools.name: vanity_board
tools.title: Browse the vanity grind-bounty board
tools.whenToUse: Use this to see what bounties exist and what they pay; workers looking for claimable work should call vanity_open.

tools.name: vanity_open
tools.title: List claimable open bounties for workers
tools.whenToUse: Use this when running a grinding worker that needs its next job; for the full board with settled bounties call vanity_board.

tools.name: vanity_stats
tools.title: Live grind-bounty market totals
tools.whenToUse: Use this for a one-line market summary; for individual bounties call vanity_board.

tools.name: vanity_leaderboard
tools.title: Top grinders by USDC earned
tools.whenToUse: Use this to see who is winning bounties; for market totals call vanity_stats.

tools.name: vanity_config
tools.title: Bounty market config: payout + asset metadata
tools.whenToUse: Call this before posting a bounty to confirm the market can pay out.

tools.name: vanity_gallery
tools.title: Browse the proof-of-grind rarity gallery
tools.whenToUse: Use this to browse published rare addresses; to score one address call vanity_appraise.

tools.name: analyze_image
tools.title: Analyze an image against a prompt
tools.whenToUse: Use this when you have a specific question about an image; for a general caption or alt text with no question, call describe_image instead.

tools.name: describe_image
tools.title: Describe an image in natural language
tools.whenToUse: Use this for alt text or a caption when you have no particular question; to ask something specific about the image, call analyze_image instead.

tools.name: get_vision_status
tools.title: Vision availability + accepted formats
tools.whenToUse: Use this before calling analyze_image / describe_image so the agent can decide whether to offer a "describe this image" action.

tools.name: x402_wallet
tools.title: The agent's x402 spending wallet (address + balance)
tools.whenToUse: Call this before pay_and_call to confirm there's USDC to spend.

tools.name: find_services
tools.title: Find paid x402 services the agent can call
tools.whenToUse: Use this when a task needs a paid API or tool you do not already have; to use a match, check its price with inspect_endpoint, then pass its resource into pay_and_call.

tools.name: inspect_endpoint
tools.title: Inspect an x402 endpoint (price + requirements, no payment)
tools.whenToUse: Use this to learn the cost before pay_and_call.

tools.name: pay_and_call
tools.title: Pay an x402 endpoint in USDC or $THREE and return its result
tools.whenToUse: Use this after inspect_endpoint has shown the price and the user has approved paying it; a settled payment cannot be undone.
